topics.title: Social Events
topics.questions: [{"en": " What kinds of social events do you prefer in your daily life? Small casual chats, group dinners, outdoor activities, or bigger parties with lots of people?", "zh": "你平时更喜欢参加什么样的社交活动？是小范围聊天、一起吃饭、户外活动，还是人多一点的聚会？"}, {"en": "At social gatherings, are you the type who takes the lead to liven up the mood, or do you sit back and observe, waiting for others to start the conversation? Do you think this comes down to your personality, or how well you know the people there?", "zh": "在社交活动中，你更像是主动带动气氛的人，还是慢慢观察、等别人先开口的人？你觉得这是性格原因，还是和熟不熟有关？"}, {"en": "What makes a social event feel comfortable to you most? A laid-back vibe, interesting shared topics, or not having to put on a fake front around everyone?", "zh": "你觉得一次社交活动让你感觉舒服，最重要的是什么？是氛围轻松、话题合拍，还是大家不用刻意表现自己？"}, {"en": "As you’ve gotten older and your lifestyle has changed, has your need for socializing shifted at all? Do you feel like meeting new people more, or would you rather spend your spare time with just a handful of close, important people?", "zh": "随着年龄和生活状态变化，你对社交活动的需求有没有改变？是变得更想认识新朋友，还是更想把时间留给少数重要的人？"}]

topics.title: Spending Habits
topics.questions: [{"en": "When are you most likely to spend money? Is it when you're in a good mood, stressed out, seeing a good sale, or when someone recommends something? Do you feel like in those moments, you're buying what you actually need, or just looking for a little emotional comfort?", "zh": "什么情况下你最容易花钱：心情好、压力大、看到打折，还是被别人推荐？你觉得那一刻买的是真正需要，还是一种情绪上的满足？"}, {"en": "What’s your standard for something being \"worth the money\"? Is it how often you’ll use it, the quality, a good price, or just the fact that it makes your life a little better? Can you give an example?", "zh": " 对你来说，“值得买”的标准是什么？是使用频率高、质量好、价格合适，还是它能让你感觉生活变好了一点？能举个例子吗？"}, {"en": "Do you ever change your mind about buying something because of social media, friends' recommendations, or influencer reviews? Do you think that helps you discover cool stuff, or just makes it easier to buy things you don't really need?", "zh": "你会不会因为社交媒体、朋友推荐或博主测评而改变自己的消费决定？你觉得这是帮你发现好东西，还是让你更容易想买不需要的东西？"}, {"en": "Do you think a person’s spending habits reflect their lifestyle or values? Like, are they more focused on efficiency, experiences, saving face, feeling secure, or just treating themselves?", "zh": "你觉得一个人的消费习惯能不能反映他的生活状态或价值观？比如更在意效率、体验、面子、安全感，还是自我奖励？"}]

topics.title: Being Someone People Can Count On
topics.questions: [{"en": "What’s the easiest way to tell if someone is truly reliable? Is it showing up on time, replying to texts quickly, or just remembering to do what they promised?", "zh": "你觉得一个人“靠谱”，最简单的表现是什么？是准时到、及时回复消息，还是答应的事会记得做？"}, {"en": "Is there someone in your life you’d call super dependable? What do they usually do that makes you feel you can always count on them?", "zh": "你身边有没有一个你觉得很靠谱的人？他/她平时做了什么，让你有这种感觉？"}, {"en": "Say you promise to do something, but then realize you actually can’t pull it off. How do you usually handle it? Do you speak up early, try to force it through, or wait until the last minute to say something? Which of those do you think is the most acceptable?", "zh": "当你答应了一件事，但后来发现自己有点做不到时，你通常会怎么处理？是提前说明、硬撑到底，还是拖到最后才开口？哪种方式你最能接受？"}, {"en": "How do you think someone can become a more reliable person? What kind of changes do they need to make?", "zh": "你觉得如何才能成为一个靠谱的人？需要在哪些方面做出改变？"}]

topics.title: My Favorite Way to Travel
topics.questions: [{"en": " If you had to describe your ideal way to travel, what would it sound like? Are you more about keeping things chill and free, or packing in as much as possible?", "zh": "如果让你描述一下自己最喜欢的旅行方式，你会怎么形容它？你更在意轻松、自由，还是丰富、充实？"}, {"en": "When you hit the road, do you prefer having everything planned out, or just going with the flow? Does a solid itinerary give you peace of mind, or does it kind of kill the magic of unexpected surprises? Has there ever been a trip that totally changed how you feel about this?", "zh": "你旅行时通常更喜欢提前规划好，还是走到哪儿算哪儿？你觉得计划会让你更安心，还是反而限制了惊喜？有没有哪次经历让你的想法变了？"}, {"en": "What makes a place a \"must-visit-again\" spot for you? Is it the scenery, the locals, the food, or honestly, just the headspace you were in at the time?", "zh": "对你来说，什么样的地方最容易成为“想再去一次”的地方？是风景、人、食物，还是当时自己的状态更重要？"}, {"en": "How do you define the whole \"meaning of travel\"? For you, is it more about unwinding, escaping reality, exploring new places, or just hitting the reset button on yourself?", "zh": "你会怎么理解“旅行的意义”？它对你来说更像放松、逃离、探索，还是一种重新整理自己的机会？"}]

topics.title: How to Stay Focused
topics.questions: [{"en": "Think about the last time you found it really hard to focus. What were you doing? Was the task too boring, too challenging, or were you simply not in the right mindset to concentrate?", "zh": "你最近一次觉得自己很难专注，是在做什么事情的时候？是任务本身太无聊、太难，还是你当时的状态就不太适合投入？"}, {"en": "When you're trying to focus on something important, what usually distracts you the most? Is it notifications on your phone, things happening around you, or random thoughts that suddenly pop into your head?", "zh": "当你准备认真做一件事时，最常把你注意力拉走的是什么？是手机消息、环境干扰，还是脑子里突然冒出来的各种想法？"}, {"en": "Have you ever had an experience where you got so absorbed in something that time seemed to fly by? Do you think it was because you genuinely enjoyed what you were doing, or because your goal was clear and there were very few distractions?", "zh": "你有没有过那种一进入状态，就感觉时间过得很快的经历？当时是因为你喜欢那件事，还是因为目标很清楚、没有太多打扰？"}, {"en": "When something is important but you just can't seem to focus on it, how do you usually deal with it? Do you force yourself to get started right away, put it off for a while, or find a different way to ease yourself into the task?", "zh": "如果一件事很重要但你迟迟专注不起来，你通常会怎么处理？是逼自己马上开始，先拖一会儿，还是换个方式让自己慢慢进入状态？"}]

topics.title: Adjusting to a New Environment
topics.questions: [{"en": "When you arrive in a new environment, how long does it usually take before you start to feel familiar with it? What makes you feel like you’ve truly settled in or become part of it?", "zh": "你到了一个新环境之后，一般多久会觉得“开始熟悉了”？什么事情会让你觉得自己真正融入了？"}, {"en": "If you moved to a new city, started a new job, or joined a new social circle, what would worry you the most? Making friends, adapting to new rules, or feeling like you might not belong?", "zh": "如果换了一个新城市、新工作或者新圈子，你最担心的会是什么？是交朋友、适应规则，还是担心自己找不到归属感？"}, {"en": "Do you think a person’s ability to adapt to a new environment comes more from experience, or from having a strong sense of inner security and confidence?", "zh": "你觉得一个人适应新环境的能力，更多来自经验，还是来自内心的安全感？"}, {"en": "If a friend of yours were trying to adjust to a new environment, what advice would you most want to give them?", "zh": "如果身边有一个朋友正在努力适应新环境，你最想给他什么建议？"}]

topics.title: Compliments and Encouragement
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you usually compliment people proactively? When you admire or appreciate someone, do you tend to tell them directly, or keep it to yourself? Why?", "zh": "你平时会主动夸奖别人吗？当你欣赏一个人时，你更习惯直接表达出来，还是放在心里？为什么？"}, {"en": "Looking back, is there a compliment or word of encouragement that has stayed with you for years? What was the situation, and why did it have such a lasting impact on you?", "zh": "回想一下，有没有一句夸奖或鼓励的话，让你记了很多年？当时发生了什么？为什么这句话会对你产生那么大的影响？"}, {"en": "Why do you think adults seem to compliment each other less often? Is it because they’re not used to expressing it, they want to avoid awkwardness, or they feel people no longer need that kind of encouragement?", "zh": "你觉得成年人为什么越来越少直接夸奖别人了？是不善表达，怕尴尬，还是觉得大家已经不需要这些了？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the most important role of compliments and encouragement? Is it to build confidence, strengthen relationships, or help people recognize strengths and value in themselves that they may not have noticed before?", "zh": "你觉得夸奖和鼓励最重要的作用是什么？是增强信心、改善关系，还是让一个人看到自己原本没注意到的价值？"}]

topics.title: Saying “No” Without Feeling Guilty
topics.questions: [{"en": "Has there ever been a time when you really didn’t want to agree to something, but still said yes because you felt bad about refusing? Looking back, did you feel more regret, frustration, or just think, “It’s fine, not a big deal”?", "zh": "有没有哪次你明明很不想答应，但最后还是因为“不好意思拒绝”而同意了？后来你对这件事更多是后悔、委屈，还是觉得“算了也没什么”？"}, {"en": "When you turn people down, what kind of pressure do you feel most strongly? Are you afraid of making things awkward, disappointing the other person, or seeming unfriendly? Where do you think that pressure usually comes from?", "zh": "你平时拒绝别人时，最容易产生哪种压力？是怕关系变尴尬、让对方失望，还是担心自己显得不够好相处？这种压力通常来自哪里？"}, {"en": "Do you find it easier to say no to strangers or to people close to you? Why? Sometimes the closer someone is to us, the harder it is to refuse them. Do you feel the same way?", "zh": "你更容易拒绝陌生人，还是关系亲近的人？为什么？有时候越亲近的人，反而越难开口说“不”。你会有这种感觉吗？"}, {"en": "If you could become more comfortable saying “no” in the future, what would you most want to change first? Your way of expressing it, the guilt you feel, or how much you care about other people’s opinions?", "zh": "如果以后能更自然地说“不”，你最希望先改变哪一点？是表达方式、心理负担，还是对别人评价的在意程度？"}]

topics.title: Patience in Daily Life
topics.questions: [{"en": "In what situations do you lose patience most easily? Is it when waiting, when communication isn’t going smoothly, or when things are moving too slowly? What do you think actually frustrates you in those moments?", "zh": "你通常在什么情况下最容易失去耐心？是等待、沟通不顺，还是事情进展太慢？你觉得那一刻真正让你烦躁的是什么？"}, {"en": "Do you notice that when you’re not in a good state mentally or emotionally, your patience for everything becomes smaller? For example, replying to messages, listening to people talk, or even waiting for an elevator can start to feel annoying. Are you usually aware of that change?", "zh": "你会不会发现，自己状态不好的时候，对很多事情的耐心都会变少？比如回消息、听别人说话，甚至连等个电梯都会烦。你一般能意识到这种变化吗？"}, {"en": "Would you describe yourself as an impatient person? In daily life, does that personality help you more, or does it mostly make you feel stressed and exhausted?", "zh": "你觉得自己是“急性子”吗？这种性格在生活里更多是帮到你，还是让你容易累和着急？"}, {"en": "What do you think could help you become a more patient person? How can you keep a calmer mindset instead of always feeling rushed or irritated?", "zh": "你觉得怎么样能让自己变得更多一些耐心？如何能让自己的心态更加平和而不急躁？"}]

topics.title: The Real You vs The You Others See
topics.titleZh: 真实的自己 vs 展现出来的自己
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you act very differently around different people? For example, does the way you talk or your personality change when you’re with friends, family, or coworkers? Which version feels closest to the real you?", "zh": "你会不会在不同的人面前，状态完全不一样？比如和朋友、家人、同事聊天时，说话方式和性格都会变。你觉得哪个更接近真正的自己？"}, {"en": "Around what kind of people do you find yourself hiding parts of who you are? And around what kind of people do you feel most comfortable being your real self? What do you think is the main reason for that?", "zh": "在什么样的人面前，你会特别容易“隐藏自己”？在什么样的人面前，你会特别容易“展现真实的自己”？你觉得主要原因是什么"}, {"en": "Do you usually express your real emotions openly, or do you tend to hide them at first? For example, when you’re sad, stressed, or not feeling your best, do you talk about it directly, or do you usually act like you’re “fine”?", "zh": "你平时更习惯把真实情绪表现出来，还是先藏一下？比如难过、压力大、没状态的时候，你会直接说，还是习惯表现得“还行”？"}, {"en": "Do you want people to understand the real you more deeply, or do you feel it’s actually better to keep a little distance?", "zh": "你希望别人更了解真实的你，还是觉得保留一点距离也挺好？"}]

topics.title: Being Alone vs Being With Others
topics.titleZh: 一个人 vs 和别人一起
topics.questions: [{"en": "In what situations do you especially want to be alone? Does being alone feel more like a way to rest, sort yourself out, or escape from the outside world?", "zh": "你在什么情况下会特别想一个人待着？这种“一个人”的需求，对你来说更像休息、整理自己，还是一种逃离外界的方式？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the biggest difference between doing things alone and doing things with other people? Besides efficiency or having a lively atmosphere, do they affect your emotions or the way you experience things?", "zh": "你觉得“一个人做事”和“和别人一起做事”，最大的区别是什么？除了效率和热闹感之外，它们会不会影响你的情绪状态或对事情的体验？"}, {"en": "Is there something you used to always do with other people, but later started to enjoy doing alone? Do you think that change came from personal growth, life experiences, or a different understanding of relationships and yourself?", "zh": "有没有哪件事，你以前习惯和别人一起，后来却开始享受一个人完成？这种变化是因为成长、经历，还是你对关系和自我状态的理解变了？"}, {"en": "If you had to choose a long-term lifestyle, would you prefer one that’s lively and full of companionship, or quiet but with more freedom? What matters most to you behind that choice?", "zh": "如果让你选择一种长期生活状态，你更倾向于“热闹但有人陪伴”，还是“安静但更自由”？这个选择背后，对你来说最重要的是什么？"}]

topics.title: Daily Habits That Make You Happier
topics.titleZh: 提升幸福感的日常习惯
topics.questions: [{"en": "Is there a small daily habit that noticeably affects how your whole day goes? It may not be “productive,” but it makes you feel more comfortable or emotionally steady. Why do you think it works for you?", "zh": "有没有一个很小的日常习惯，会明显影响你一天的状态？它可能并不“高效”，但会让你感觉更舒服、更稳定。你觉得它为什么对你有作用？"}, {"en": "When you’re not feeling great, what usually helps you recover the most? Spending time alone, talking to someone, or just doing small and simple things?", "zh": "当你状态不太好的时候，通常做什么最能让自己缓过来？是一个人待着、找人聊天，还是做点很简单的小事？"}, {"en": "Have you noticed that some very ordinary moments can actually make you feel surprisingly happy? Like good weather, buying something you like on the way home, or having a really good conversation with someone. Do you find yourself appreciating these little moments more and more?", "zh": "你有没有发现，某些看起来很普通的小事，其实特别能提升幸福感？比如天气好、下班路上买到喜欢的东西，或者和谁聊得很开心。你会不会越来越在意这些小瞬间？"}, {"en": "If happiness is seen as a long-term state rather than just a temporary emotion, what do you think is the most important daily skill or habit for maintaining it?", "zh": " 如果把“幸福感”理解成一种长期状态，而不是短暂情绪，你觉得最重要的日常能力是什么？"}]

topics.title: Methods and tools for learning English lately
topics.titleZh: 最近学习英语的方法和工具
topics.questions: [{"en": "What methods have you mainly been using to learn English lately? Watching videos, memorizing vocabulary, talking with other people, or using AI and learning apps? Why do you prefer that method?", "zh": "你最近主要是通过什么方式学习英语的？是刷视频、背单词、和别人交流，还是使用AI或学习软件？你为什么会更倾向这种方式？"}, {"en": "When it comes to learning English, do you care more about “efficiency” or “being able to stick with it long-term”? Have you found any methods that may feel slow, but actually work better for you over time?", "zh": "在学习英语这件事上，你更看重“效率”，还是“长期能坚持”？有没有哪种方法虽然进步慢，但反而更适合你长期使用？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the biggest difference between learning English now and in the past? For example, the way people access learning resources, the pace of learning, or the rise of AI tools. Do you think these changes have really made learning easier?", "zh": "你觉得现在学习英语，和以前最大的不同是什么？比如获取资源的方式、学习节奏，或者AI工具的出现。你觉得这些变化真的让学习变容易了吗？"}, {"en": "If you had to describe the English-learning method that works best for you right now, how would you describe it? What do you think is the real reason it works so well for you?", "zh": "如果让你总结一种“目前对自己最有效的英语学习方式”，你会怎么描述？这种方法真正起作用的原因是什么？"}]

topics.title: Putting Things Off
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you ever have those moments when you know you need to get something done, but you just keep putting it off and don’t start?", "zh": "你有没有那种明明有事情要做，但就是一直拖着不开始的时候？"}, {"en": " In what situations are you most likely to procrastinate? When a task is too difficult, too boring, or when it feels like you still have plenty of time?", "zh": "你更容易在哪种情况下拖延？是任务太难、太无聊，还是时间看起来还很多？"}, {"en": "Do you think procrastination is more of a “time management issue,” or more of an emotional or psychological one?", "zh": "你觉得拖延更多是“时间管理问题”，还是“情绪或心理问题”？"}, {"en": " If you wanted to cut down on procrastination a bit, what’s the most realistic first step for you? Starting with something small, removing distractions, or giving yourself a clearer way to begin?", "zh": "如果要减少一点拖延，你觉得对你来说最现实的一步是什么？是先做一点点、关掉干扰，还是给自己一个更具体的开始方式？"}]

topics.title: Small Conflicts in Daily Life
topics.questions: [{"en": "Can you think of a small conflict you had recently indaily life? What is a common small conflict between friends, rroommates, or classmates in your experience?", "zh": "你能想到最近在日常生活中发生的一次小摩擦吗？根据你的经验,朋友、室友或同学之间最常见的一种小摩擦是什么?"}, {"en": "When someone does something that bothers you, how do you usually react at first?", "zh": "当有人做了让你不舒服的事时,你一开始通常会怎么反应?"}, {"en": "How can people solve a small disagreement politelywithout making the situation worse?", "zh": "人们怎样才能礼貌地解决一个小分歧,而不让情况变得更糟?"}, {"en": "In your opinion, what is the difference between a smallconflict that can be ignored and one that should be discusseed seriously?", "zh": "在你看来,什么样的小摩擦可以忽略,什么样又应该认真讨论,它们的区别是什么?"}]

topics.title: Working with Different Kinds of People
topics.questions: [{"en": "What kind of people do you usually enjoy working or studying with?", "zh": "你通常喜欢和什么样的人一起工作或学习？"}, {"en": "When you work in a group, what role do you usually take, and why?", "zh": "当你在团队中合作时，你通常会扮演什么角色？为什么？"}, {"en": "What do you do when you have to work with someone who has a very different personality from yours?", "zh": "当你必须和一个性格和你很不一样的人合作时，你会怎么做？"}, {"en": "In the future, what kind of team culture would help different kinds of people work well together?", "zh": "在未来，什么样的团队文化能帮助不同类型的人更好地一起合作？"}]

topics.title: Communicating Well
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever experienced this: what someone said was technically correct, but it still made you feel uncomfortable? Do you think the issue was more about what they said, or how they said it?", "zh": "你有没有遇到过那种：对方说的话没错，但就是让你听着不舒服？你觉得问题更多在内容，还是在说话的方式？"}, {"en": "When you’re not in a great mood, does your way of speaking change noticeably? For example, do you become more blunt, less patient, or just not feel like talking at all?", "zh": "当你心情不太好的时候，说话方式会有明显变化吗？比如变得更直接、没耐心，或者干脆不想说话？"}, {"en": "Do you think “communicating well” is more about skills or attitude? Is it something that can be improved through learning better ways to express yourself, or does it depend more on your willingness to understand others and manage your emotions?", "zh": "你觉得“好好说话”是技巧问题，还是态度问题？是可以通过学习改善的表达方式，还是更取决于是否愿意理解对方、控制情绪？"}, {"en": "If you wanted to make your communication smoother, what would you most want to improve? Your way of expressing yourself, being more patient, or learning how to say what you really mean more clearly?", "zh": "如果要让沟通变得更顺一点，你觉得自己最想改的一点是什么？是表达方式、更有耐心，还是学会把想说的话说清楚？"}]

topics.title: Which Matters More—Choices or Effort?
topics.titleZh: 选择和努力哪个更重要
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever felt like you were working really hard, but maybe the direction wasn’t right from the start? At the time, did you keep going or eventually change course? Looking back now, how do you see that choice?", "zh": "你有没有那种感觉：自己已经很努力了，但好像方向一开始就不太对？当时你是继续坚持，还是后来换了方向？现在回头看，你会怎么评价当时的选择？"}, {"en": "If you had to choose, would you be more afraid of “choosing the wrong path,” or “choosing the right path but not putting in enough effort”? Which do you think is more regretful?", "zh": "如果现在让你选，是更怕“选错路”，还是更怕“选对了但自己不够努力”？你觉得哪种情况更让人遗憾？"}, {"en": "Do you ever hesitate to start something because you’re worried you might choose the wrong direction from the very beginning?", "zh": "你会不会有那种时候，一直在纠结要不要开始，因为怕一开始就选错？"}, {"en": "If you could give your past self just one piece of advice, would you lean more toward “choose the right direction” or “stick with it a bit longer”?", "zh": "如果只能给过去的自己一个建议，你会更倾向于说“选对方向”，还是“多坚持一点”？"}]

topics.title: Education
topics.questions: [{"en": "Looking back on your years in school, which stage of education had the biggest impact on you? How did high school and university shape your learning ability and the way you see the world?", "zh": "在你的整个上学过程中，哪段教育对你产生的影响最大？在高中和大学阶段，分别对你的学习能力和个人认知产生了什么影响？"}, {"en": "If you could go through a stage of your education again, what would you most want to change? Your study methods, your attitude toward learning, or your mindset?", "zh": "如果现在让你重新经历一段学习阶段，你最希望改变的是什么？是学习方式、学习态度、还是学习心态？"}, {"en": "Have you ever experienced intense academic competition (the kind people often call “education rat race”)? Do you think this is more of a personal choice, or something shaped by the environment that’s hard to avoid?", "zh": "你经历过“教育内卷”吗？关于“教育内卷”，你觉得它更多是个人选择，还是一种难以避免的环境？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the main purpose of education? Is it to gain knowledge, build skills, or shape values and character? Do you think the goals and methods of education will change in the future?", "zh": "你认为教育的目标是什么？是获取知识、培养技能，还是塑造价值观和人格？你觉得未来这种教育的目标和方式会发生改变吗？"}]

topics.title: Balancing Work, Health, and Life
topics.titleZh: 工作、健康与生活的平衡
topics.questions: [{"en": "What does your life look like right now? Does work take up most of your energy, or do you still have room for your health and personal life? Is this something you’ve chosen for yourself, or is it more driven by your environment?", "zh": "你现在是怎样的生活状态？是工作占据了大部分精力，还是还能留出空间给健康和生活？这种状态是你主动选择的，还是被环境推动的？"}, {"en": "Do you ever have moments when you know you should rest, but still can’t stop yourself from working or scrolling on your phone? In those moments, do you actually feel relaxed, or does it end up draining you even more?", "zh": "你会不会有那种“明知道该休息，但还是忍不住继续工作或刷手机”的时候？当下你是觉得放松，还是其实更消耗？"}, {"en": "Do you usually plan time for exercise on purpose, or just do it when you happen to have time? When work gets busy, is exercise the first thing you drop, or do you try to keep it as part of your routine?", "zh": "你平时会刻意安排运动吗，还是等有时间再说？当工作忙起来的时候，运动通常是最先被放弃的，还是你会尽量保留？"}, {"en": "How do you feel about “being lazy”? Do you feel a bit guilty about it, or do you see it as a way to recharge? Do you think even relaxing can sometimes turn into a kind of pressure for you?", "zh": "你对“偷懒”这件事是什么态度？是会有点负罪感，还是觉得这是恢复状态的一种方式？你觉得自己会不会连放松都变成一种压力？"}]

topics.title: City
topics.questions: [{"en": "Which city are you currently living in? How does this city make you feel in terms of both work and daily life?", "zh": "你目前是在哪座城市？这座城市在生活和工作方面带给你什么样的感受？"}, {"en": "After living in a city for a long time, do you think it changes you? For example, your pace of life or your values. Have you noticed any changes that were actually shaped by the environment around you?", "zh": "在一座城市生活久了，你觉得自己会被它改变吗？比如生活节奏、价值观。你有没有意识到哪些变化其实是“被环境塑造”的？"}, {"en": "Which city do you dream of living in the most? Why?", "zh": "你最向往的城市是哪里？为什么？"}, {"en": "If you had the choice, would you prefer to stay in a big city or move somewhere with a slower pace of life? For you, is that choice more about practical considerations, or about the kind of lifestyle you want?", "zh": "如果有机会选择，你更倾向于留在大城市，还是去相对节奏更慢的地方生活？这个选择对你来说，更像是现实考量，还是一种对生活方式的判断？"}]

topics.title: Effective Ways to Learn
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever gone through a period where your learning efficiency was especially high? What was different back then compared to now? Was it the environment, clearer goals, or better methods? What do you think actually made the biggest difference?", "zh": "你有没有一段学习效率特别高的经历？当时和现在有什么不同？是环境、目标更清晰，还是方法更合适？你觉得真正起作用的因素是什么？"}, {"en": "When you feel like you just “can’t get into studying,” what’s usually the problem? Is it your focus, your mood, the difficulty level, or simply a lack of interest in the material? How do you figure it out and adjust?", "zh": "当你觉得“学不进去”的时候，通常是哪里出了问题？是注意力、情绪、难度不匹配，还是对内容本身缺乏兴趣？你会怎么判断并调整？"}, {"en": "When it comes to learning, do you rely more on external structure (like plans, check-ins, or courses) or internal motivation (like interest and a sense of purpose)? What do you do to improve your learning efficiency?", "zh": "在学习过程中，你更依赖外在因素（计划、打卡、课程），还是内在驱动（兴趣、目标感）？你会采取哪些行动来提升自己的学习效率？"}, {"en": "If you see learning as a long-term process rather than a short-term task, what do you think is the most important ability? Is it focus, the ability to get feedback, the habit of reflection, or your tolerance for not understanding things right away? Which of these do you most want to improve right now?", "zh": "如果把学习看作一个长期过程，而不是短期任务，你觉得最关键的能力是什么？是专注力、反馈能力、复盘习惯，还是对“不会”的耐受度？你现在最想提升哪一点？"}]

topics.title: Movies or Music in Your Life
topics.titleZh: 你生活中的电影或音乐
topics.questions: [{"en": "Is there a song you’ve been playing on repeat lately, or a show/movie you keep watching? Is it because of the melody, the storyline, or because it matches how you’ve been feeling recently?", "zh": "你最近有没有循环听的一首歌，或者一直在看的剧/电影？是因为旋律、剧情，还是刚好很符合你最近的心情？"}, {"en": "When do you usually listen to music or watch movies? For example, during your commute, while doing chores, or when relaxing alone. For you, is it more of a habit or something you actually feel you need?", "zh": "你平时更习惯在什么情况下听音乐或看电影？比如通勤、做家务、一个人放松的时候。对你来说，这更像一种习惯，还是一种需要？"}, {"en": "Is there a song or a movie that had a particularly big impact on you at some point in your life? What was going on in your life at that time? Why did that piece of music or film resonate with you then?", "zh": "有没有一首歌或一部电影，在某个阶段对你产生过特别大的影响？当时的你正处在什么样的状态？为什么那部作品会在那个时间点打动你？"}, {"en": "What role do movies or music play in your life? How do they influence or affect your everyday life?", "zh": "你觉得电影或音乐在你的生活中扮演了什么角色？对你的生活产生了什么影响？"}]

topics.title: Learning to Say “No”
topics.questions: [{"en": "In what situations do you find it hardest to say “no” to others? Is it when dealing with people close to you, requests at work, or when you’re worried about how others might judge you? Where do you think that hesitation usually comes from?", "zh": "在什么样的情况下，你最难对别人说“不”？是面对关系亲近的人、工作上的请求，还是当你担心影响别人对你的评价时？这种犹豫通常来自哪里？"}, {"en": "When you agree to do something that you actually don’t really want to do, how do you usually feel inside? Do you feel frustrated or drained, or do you try to convince yourself that “it’s not a big deal”? After experiencing this many times, does it change the way you see yourself?", "zh": "当你答应了一件其实并不太愿意做的事情时，你内心通常会有什么感受？是觉得委屈、内耗，还是会试着说服自己“其实也没关系”？这种经历多了以后，会不会改变你对自己的看法？"}, {"en": "Why do you think people often struggle to say “no”? Is it more because of kindness, a sense of responsibility, or fear of damaging relationships?", "zh": "你觉得人们不敢说“不”，更多是因为善良、责任感，还是害怕关系受影响？"}, {"en": "If you want to feel more comfortable saying “no” in the future, what do you think you would need to change most? Your way of expressing it, your worries about relationships, or the expectations you place on yourself?", "zh": "如果以后想更自在地说“不”，你觉得自己最需要改变的是什么？是表达方式、对关系的担心，还是对自己的要求？"}]

topics.title: Dealing with Uncertainty in Life
topics.titleZh: 如何面对生活中的不确定性
topics.questions: [{"en": "Is there anything recently that has made you feel like “it’s hard to say how it will turn out”? Does that uncertainty feel more like pressure, or more like a worry about something that hasn’t happened yet?", "zh": "最近有没有什么事情是你一直觉得“说不准会怎么样”的？这种不确定对你来说更多是压力，还是一种还没发生的担心？"}, {"en": "When things don’t go according to your original plan, how do you usually react? Do you adjust your plan right away, or do you spend some time feeling stuck or conflicted first?", "zh": "当事情没有按照你原来的计划发展时，你通常会怎么反应？是马上调整计划，还是会先纠结一段时间？"}, {"en": "When facing an uncertain future, do you tend to prepare a lot in advance, or do you prefer to figure things out as you go?", "zh": "面对不太确定的未来，你更习惯提前做很多准备，还是边走边看？"}, {"en": "If uncertainty is an unavoidable part of life, what helps you feel more grounded? Is it your abilities, your past experience, the people around you, or a certain level of trust in yourself?", "zh": "如果生活一定会有很多不确定的地方，你觉得什么能让你比较踏实？是能力、经验、身边的人，还是对自己的某种信任？"}]

topics.title: The Impact of AI
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you use AI tools in your daily life? What do you usually use them for? How has AI affected your work or everyday life?", "zh": "你平时会用AI工具吗？一般是用来干什么的？AI对你的工作和生活带来了哪些影响？"}, {"en": "Do you think your job could be replaced by AI in the future? In your line of work, what kinds of tasks could AI handle, and what kinds of things do you think it still can’t do?", "zh": "你觉得你的工作有可能被AI取代吗？针对你的工作，AI能做哪些事情？不能做哪些事情？"}, {"en": "If you think of AI as a powerful “assistant,” what kinds of tasks would you most want it to help you with? What new opportunities do you think AI might create for ordinary people?", "zh": "如果把AI当成一个很强的“助手”，你最想让它帮你做哪类事情？你觉得AI最可能给普通人带来的新机会是什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think the abilities people need will change as AI continues to develop? How can someone stay competitive in the age of AI?", "zh": "你觉得面对AI的发展，人最需要培养的能力会发生变化吗？如何让自己在AI时代保持足够的竞争力？"}]

topics.title: Career Choices
topics.questions: [{"en": "What is your current job? When you first chose this career path, what was the most important factor in your decision?", "zh": "你现在的职业是什么的？你当初选择现在这条职业方向时，最重要的考虑因素是什么？"}, {"en": "Have you ever thought about changing jobs or even switching industries? Why or why not? If you were to make a change, what kind of work would you most like to do?", "zh": "你有考虑过换工作或者换行业吗？原因是什么？如果想换的话，你最想做什么工作？"}, {"en": "When it comes to career decisions, do you value job stability more, or greater opportunities for growth? How do you tell whether a job is truly a good fit for you?", "zh": "在职业选择中，你更看重“工作稳定”还是“更大的成长空间”？你通过哪些方面来判断这份工作是否适合你？"}, {"en": "At this stage of your life, does your job have too much influence over your daily routine or personal life? How do you think you can create a better balance between work and life?", "zh": "在当前阶段，你的工作会过度影响你的生活节奏吗？你觉得怎么能平衡工作与生活？"}]

topics.title: How Was Your Spring Festival Holiday?
topics.questions: [{"en": "How was your holiday overall? What did you do during the break, and how did it feel?", "zh": "这个假期你过得怎么样？都做了哪些事情？整体的假期感受怎么样？"}, {"en": "During the holiday, did you feel any tension between traditional customs (like visiting relatives or family banquets) and your personal needs (such as rest or alone time)? How did you balance the two?", "zh": "在假期中，你是否感受到传统习俗（如拜年、聚餐）与个人需求（如休息、独处）之间的冲突？你是如何平衡这两者的？"}, {"en": "At family gatherings, did questions from relatives (about work, marriage, income, etc.) make you feel pressured? Did you answer honestly, or did you rely on polite “safe” responses?", "zh": "春节聚会中，家人或亲戚的提问（如工作、婚姻、收入）是否让你感到压力？你是选择坦诚回应，还是用“社交话术”应对？"}, {"en": "After the holiday ended, did you feel drained with a kind of “post-holiday slump,” or motivated for the next stage? How do you think one can quickly get back into study or work mode?", "zh": "春节结束后，你是感到“假期综合征”的疲惫，还是对新阶段充满动力？你觉得应该怎么快速调整状态来让自己适应学习或工作？"}]

topics.title: Small Moments of Happiness
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your day-to-day life, what small moments most easily make you feel like “this is actually pretty nice”? Do these moments happen by chance, or do you intentionally make space for them?", "zh": "在你的一天里，通常是什么样的小瞬间最容易让你觉得“这一刻挺好的”？这些瞬间是偶然发生的，还是你刻意为自己保留的？"}, {"en": "Is there any small habit or ritual that may seem ordinary, but is especially meaningful to you?", "zh": "有没有一种看起来很普通，但对你来说特别重要的小习惯或小仪式？"}, {"en": "When you’re in a bad mood or under a lot of stress, do these small moments of happiness really help? What kind of impact do they have on your life?", "zh": "当你心情不好或压力很大的时候，小确幸真的能帮到你吗？对你的生活有什么样的影响？"}, {"en": "Looking back on recent days or weeks, do you feel like these small moments of happiness are becoming more frequent or less frequent? Why do you think that is?", "zh": "如果让你回顾最近一段时间，你觉得自己的小确幸是在“变多”，还是“变少”？你觉得原因是什么？"}]

topics.title: Habits
topics.questions: [{"en": "What good habits do you have? How do they affect your work or daily life? How did you develop these habits in the first place?", "zh": "你有哪些好的习惯？这些习惯对你的工作或生活有哪些影响？你是怎么养成这些习惯的？"}, {"en": "Do you have any habits that you know aren’t great, but just can’t seem to break? How do they affect your work or life? Why do you think it’s so hard for you to change them?", "zh": "你有没有那种“明知道不太好，但就是改不掉”的习惯？这个习惯对你的工作或生活有哪些影响？你觉得自己改不掉的原因是什么？"}, {"en": "Is there a habit you’ve wanted to build but never quite managed to stick with? Why do you think it didn’t work out?", "zh": "有没有一种习惯，是你自己想养成但是始终没有形成习惯的？你觉得没有成功的原因是什么？"}, {"en": "Habits shape how we live and how we act based on past experience. At the same time, do you think habits can limit us from exploring other possibilities? How do you balance sticking to your habits with trying new things?", "zh": "习惯影响着我们的生活，让我们根据自己的经验做事情。与此同时，你认为习惯会束缚你探索其他的可能性吗？你怎么来平衡 习惯 和 尝试新的可能性 之间的关系"}]

topics.title: Spring Festival Traditions and Memories
topics.questions: [{"en": "What Spring Festival traditions are there in your hometown? Which one feels the most meaningful or ceremonial to you?", "zh": "在你家乡的春节里，都有哪些春节习俗？哪一个习俗对你来说最有“仪式感”？"}, {"en": "How did you celebrate the Spring Festival when you were a child, and how do you celebrate it now? Have your feelings about the holiday changed in any noticeable way?", "zh": "你小时候和现在，分别是怎么度过春节的？对春节的感受有什么明显变化？"}, {"en": "During family gatherings like the Spring Festival, are there any feelings you experience year after year? For example, excitement, pressure, feeling cared for, being compared to others, or a vague sense of inner conflict. How do you usually deal with these feelings?", "zh": "在春节这样的家庭场合中，有没有哪种感受是你每年都会反复经历的？比如期待、压力、被关心、被比较，或是某种说不清的矛盾感？你通常如何看待这些感受？"}, {"en": "If you could decide how to celebrate the Spring Festival in the future, what would you most want to keep, and what would you most want to change?", "zh": "如果让你决定未来如何过春节，你最想保留什么，又最想改变什么？"}]

topics.title: How to Deal with Being Compared
topics.questions: [{"en": "When was the last time you felt like you were being “compared,” and in what situation did it happen? Was it something someone casually said, or a comparison you made in your own mind? What were you thinking at that moment?", "zh": "你最近一次感觉“被比较”，大概是在什么场景下？是别人随口一句话，还是你自己在心里默默对比？那一刻你在想什么？"}, {"en": "When you realize you’re being compared to someone else, how do you usually react? Do you brush it off with a smile on the surface, or do you keep replaying it in your head afterward? Is this a reaction you’ve gotten used to?", "zh": "当你发现自己被拿来和别人比的时候，你通常会怎么反应？表面一笑而过，还是心里会反复想很久？这种反应你习惯了吗？"}, {"en": "What kind of comparisons affect you the most—work, income, or lifestyle? Why does that particular area hit you the hardest?", "zh": "你觉得哪种比较对你影响最大？是工作、收入，还是生活状态？为什么偏偏是这一点最戳你？"}, {"en": "If being compared is unavoidable, what do you think helps you keep a healthy mindset when dealing with it?", "zh": "如果无法避免被比较，你觉得哪些事情是可以让自己保持良好心态来对待的？"}]

topics.title: Health and Physical Condition
topics.questions: [{"en": "What signs usually tell you that your physical condition is getting worse? Is it pain, fatigue, sleep problems, or changes in your mood and ability to focus?", "zh": "你通常是通过哪些信号，意识到自己的身体状态在变差？是疼痛、疲劳、睡眠问题，还是情绪和专注力的变化？"}, {"en": "How do you see the relationship between your physical health and your emotional or mental state? Have you ever noticed that when your body feels unwell, your mood drops or you become more irritable?", "zh": "你觉得身体状态和情绪、心理状态之间是什么关系？有没有过身体不舒服时，情绪明显更低落或更易烦躁的经历？"}, {"en": "When it comes to “managing your health,” are you more proactive or reactive? Do you try to prevent problems through regular exercise, diet, and sleep routines, or do you only make changes after something goes wrong?", "zh": "你对“健康管理”这件事更偏向主动还是被动？是通过规律运动、饮食、作息来提前预防，还是等身体出问题了再调整？"}, {"en": "In your opinion, what habits or actions are necessary to maintain good physical health?", "zh": "你觉得如果想要保持好的身体状态，需要养成哪些习惯，需要做哪些事情？"}]

topics.title: Anxiety About Free Time
topics.questions: [{"en": "When you suddenly have some “unscheduled time,” how do you usually feel inside? Do you feel relaxed, confused, or quietly uneasy?", "zh": "当你突然拥有一段“没有安排的时间”时，内心通常会出现什么感受？是放松、迷茫，还是隐约的不安？"}, {"en": "Do you unconsciously try to fill that empty time with certain habits, like scrolling on your phone, over-planning, or doing things that aren’t really important?", "zh": "你是否会下意识地用某些行为填满空白时间？比如刷手机、反复规划、做并不重要的事情"}, {"en": "If you spend a whole day without doing anything “productive,” do you feel guilty at night?", "zh": "如果一整天都没做什么“有成果”的事情，你晚上会有负罪感吗？"}, {"en": "Between being busy and being idle, which state tends to make you feel more anxious? Why?", "zh": "你觉得忙的时候和闲的时候，哪种状态更容易让你感到焦虑？为什么？"}]

topics.title: Low-Energy State
topics.questions: [{"en": "In what situations do you usually fall into a “low-energy state”? Is it caused by long-term stress building up, your life getting out of balance, or a specific event? Can you tell whether it’s physical tiredness or more of a mental or emotional drain?", "zh": "你通常在什么情况下会进入“低能量状态”？是长期压力积累、生活节奏失控，还是某个具体事件触发的？你能分清是身体疲惫，还是心理层面的消耗吗？"}, {"en": "When you’re in a low-energy state, how do your behavior and thoughts change? For example, do you start procrastinating, avoiding social interactions, losing interest in things, or becoming more self-critical?", "zh": "当你处于低能量状态时，你的行为和思维会发生哪些变化？比如拖延、回避社交、对事情失去兴趣，或是对自己变得更苛刻？"}, {"en": "Do you think “rest” always helps with a low-energy state? Why or why not? Have you ever rested but still couldn’t find the motivation to do anything? Do you feel that what really drains you is physical energy, emotional energy, or a lack of purpose or meaning?", "zh": "你觉得“休息”一定能缓解低能量状态吗？为什么？有没有过明明休息了，却依然提不起劲的经历？你觉得真正消耗你的，是体力、情绪，还是意义感的缺失？"}, {"en": "When you’re feeling low on energy, do you prefer to deal with it on your own, or do you reach out to others for help? What do you think is behind that choice?", "zh": "在低能量状态下，你更倾向于独自消化，还是向他人求助？你觉得这种选择背后的原因是什么？"}]

topics.title: A Sense of Security
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your daily life, when do you feel the most secure? Are there times when even small things can suddenly make you feel insecure?", "zh": "在日常生活中，什么时候你最有安全感？你会不会因为一些很小的事突然没安全感？"}, {"en": "When you start to feel insecure, what do you usually do to deal with it?", "zh": "当你感觉不太有安全感的时候，你通常会怎么做？"}, {"en": "Do you think a sense of security comes more easily from other people, or is it something you have to build on your own?", "zh": "你觉得“安全感”更容易从别人那里得到，还是只能靠自己建立？"}, {"en": "Do you think a sense of security naturally grows with age, income, or experience? What do you think can help you feel more secure in life?", "zh": "你觉得安全感会随着年龄、收入或经验自然增加吗？怎么能让自己获得更多的安全感"}]

topics.title: Plans for 2026
topics.questions: [{"en": "If you could make clear progress in \"just one area\" in 2026 and keep everything else the same, what would you choose? Why is this one thing worth giving up other possibilities?", "zh": "如果 2026 年你只能在“一件事”上明显前进，其余都维持现状，你会选择哪一件？为什么它值得你为之放弃其他可能性？"}, {"en": "Looking back at the past few years, do you feel like your plans are similar every year, but the results turn out very different? What do you think really stops you from following through? How do you plan to deal with that in 2026?", "zh": "回看过去几年，你是否发现自己“年年计划相似，却年年结果不同”？你认为真正限制你执行计划的因素是什么？2026 年你打算如何应对这一点？"}, {"en": "When you think about making plans for 2026, which scares you more: \"choosing the wrong path\", or \"never taking the first step at all\"?", "zh": "在做 2026 年的计划时，你更害怕哪种情况：走错路，还是一直不敢走出去？"}, {"en": "Have you set any “things you deliberately won’t do” for 2026? Do you think deciding what not to do can be even more important than deciding what to do?", "zh": "你是否为 2026 年设定了“刻意不去做的事情”？不做什么，可能比做什么更重要？"}]

topics.title: The summary of the past year
topics.questions: [{"en": "Looking back at the past year, what do you think was your biggest achievement? How did these achievements positively impact your life or work? Was there anything you regret? If you could choose again, how would you handle it?", "zh": "回顾过去一年，你觉得自己最大的收获是什么？这些收获对你的生活或工作产生了哪些积极的影响？有没有让你感到遗憾的事情？如果可以重新选择，你会如何应对？"}, {"en": "Did you accomplish the goals you set at the beginning of the year? If not, what do you think were the main reasons?", "zh": "你是否完成了年初设定的目标？如果没有完成，你觉得主要原因是什么？"}, {"en": "In what areas do you feel you’ve made noticeable progress or grown as a person? What actions or decisions led to this progress? Are there areas where you’d like to improve further?", "zh": "你觉得自己在哪些方面有了明显的进步或成长？这些进步源于哪些行动或决定？有哪些方面自己想做的更好？"}, {"en": "Regarding learning English, have you made any new achievements over the past year? Based on your experiences, what tips or lessons would you share with others?", "zh": "在学习英语方面，自己在过去一年是否有新的收获？在过去一年的经历中，有哪些学习的经验或建议可以分享？"}]

topics.title: Our Sense of Time
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you feel more aware of time these days, or does time seem to just slip by without you noticing? How do you think this change is connected to your current lifestyle?", "zh": "你觉得自己现在对时间更敏感了，还是更容易“没感觉地流走了”？这种变化和你的生活状态有什么关系？"}, {"en": "When you have a lot to do and very little time, do you usually become more productive, or do you get more anxious and start procrastinating? Why do you think that happens?", "zh": "当事情很多、时间很紧的时候，你通常是更容易变得高效，还是更容易焦虑和拖延？你觉得原因是什么？"}, {"en": "Have you ever made a careful plan but ended up not following it completely? Looking back, do you think the problem was the plan itself, or the uncertainty of real life?", "zh": "你有没有过认真做计划，但最后并没有完全按计划执行的经历？回头看，你觉得问题出在计划本身，还是现实的不确定性？"}, {"en": "Between work, study, and personal life, which one do you prefer to spend more time on? Does the way you use your time match what you truly care about?", "zh": "在工作、学习和个人生活中，你更愿意把时间留给哪一部分？这种时间分配和你内心真正重视的东西一致吗？"}]

topics.title: Speaking Up & Listening
topics.questions: [{"en": "In everyday conversations, do you think you’re better at expressing yourself or at listening? What do you see as the biggest difference between the two?", "zh": "在日常交流中，你觉得自己更擅长“表达”，还是更擅长“倾听”？你觉得两者最大的区别是什么？"}, {"en": "Have you ever really wanted to say something but didn’t know how to put it into words? When that happens, how do you usually adjust yourself?", "zh": "你有没有过“很想表达，但不知道怎么说出口”的经历？这种情况你一般会怎么调整自己？"}, {"en": "At work or in school, which way of expressing ideas do you think people are more likely to listen to: being direct and logical, or sharing examples and personal feelings? Why?", "zh": "在工作或学习中，你觉得哪些表达方式更容易被人听进去：直接说明问题、讲逻辑，还是通过举例、讲感受？为什么？"}, {"en": "What do you think real “listening” means? Is it just staying quiet and not interrupting, or does it also mean responding and giving feedback? Which do you agree with more?", "zh": "你觉得真正的“倾听”意味着什么？是安静地听、不打断，还是要给出回应和反馈？你更认同哪一种？"}]

topics.title: Food & Eating Habits
topics.questions: [{"en": "What kind of food do you enjoy the most? What are the eating habits like in your hometown? Is there any place whose food left a deep impression on you?", "zh": "你最喜欢吃什么类型的美食？你的家乡有什么样的饮食习惯？你对哪里的食物印象最深刻？"}, {"en": "Do you prefer spending time and money trying new foods, or do you feel more comfortable sticking with familiar flavors?", "zh": "你更愿意花时间和钱去尝试新的美食，还是更偏爱熟悉、安心的味道？"}, {"en": "Have your eating habits changed over the past few years? What caused the change — work, age, health, or a shift in mindset?", "zh": "你的饮食习惯在这些年里有没有发生变化？这种变化是因为工作、年龄、健康，还是心态的改变？"}, {"en": "Do you usually choose to “eat for enjoyment” or “eat for health”? How do you balance the two in real life?", "zh": "你平时更偏向“吃得开心”还是“吃得健康”？在现实生活中，这两者你是怎么取舍和平衡的？"}]

topics.title: Comfort Zone & Personal Growth
topics.titleZh: 舒适区 与 自我突破
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you feel like you’re living in your “comfort zone” right now? In your work or daily life, what things feel challenging to you, and what things feel completely comfortable?", "zh": "你觉得自己现在的生活是在“舒适区”里吗？工作和生活里的哪些事情对你来说有挑战性？哪些对你来说是“舒适区”？"}, {"en": "Do you think staying in your comfort zone is laziness, or is it a form of self-protection? In what situations do you think staying in your comfort zone is actually the wiser choice?", "zh": "你觉得“待在舒适区”到底是懒惰，还是一种自我保护？在什么情况下你会认为保持舒适区反而是明智的选择？"}, {"en": "What signs tell you that you’re stuck in the same place and need to push yourself a bit? How do you usually remind yourself to make a change?", "zh": "哪些迹象会让你意识到自己已经在“原地踏步”了，需要做一些突破？你通常会如何提醒自己改变？"}, {"en": "Do you think stepping out of your comfort zone always has to be stressful or painful? Is it possible to find a balance between feeling comfortable and still growing?", "zh": "你认为走出舒适区一定意味着痛苦和压力吗？有没有可能在舒适和成长之间找到更平衡的方式？"}]

topics.title: Confidence
topics.questions: [{"en": "Where do you think confidence comes from? From skills, experience, or recognition from others?", "zh": "你觉得自信来自哪里？是来自能力、经验，还是他人的认可？"}, {"en": "When do you usually feel less confident? What kinds of situations trigger that feeling, and how do you deal with it?", "zh": "当你感到不自信时，通常是哪些场景触发的？你会如何应对这种情绪？"}, {"en": "Do you think both “overconfidence” and “lack of confidence” can affect a person’s growth? Why?", "zh": "你是否认为“过度自信”和“缺乏自信”都会影响发展？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think confidence can be developed? What small habits can help you become more confident over time?", "zh": "你觉得自信可以培养吗？哪些小习惯能帮助你慢慢变得更自信？"}]

topics.title: Pets
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you like pets? Why or why not? If you could have a pet, what would you choose and why?", "zh": "你喜欢宠物吗？为什么或者为什么不喜欢？如果可以养一只宠物，你会选哪一种？为什么是它？"}, {"en": "What kind of people do you think are good at taking care of pets? And who might not be suitable for having pets?", "zh": "你认为什么样的人适合养宠物？哪些人可能不适合？"}, {"en": "What role can a pet play in a person’s life? How can pets change or influence their owner’s daily life?", "zh": "宠物在主人生活中能扮演什么角色？宠物能够为主人的生活产生什么样的影响？"}, {"en": "Nowadays, more and more people have pets and are willing to spend a lot of money on them, which leads to the growth of the “pet economy.” Why do you think this is happening?", "zh": "现在养宠物的人越来越多，人们也愿意为宠物花更多的钱，于是产生了“宠物经济”。你觉得产生这种现象的原因是什么？"}]

topics.title: Making Your Busy Life Feel Worth It
topics.questions: [{"en": "These days, are you busy because you have to be, or because you think it’s worth it? How do you tell the difference between the two?", "zh": "你现在的忙碌，大部分是“不得不做”，还是你认为“值得做”的？你是怎么区分这两种忙碌的？"}, {"en": "Has there ever been a time when you were super busy but still felt really fulfilled? What made that kind of busyness feel meaningful?", "zh": "有没有哪段时间，你觉得自己虽然很忙，但特别充实？是什么让那段忙碌变得有价值？"}, {"en": "When you realize you’re “busy for nothing,” how do you adjust? Do you stop and take a break, or do you reorganize your plans?", "zh": "当你发现自己“忙得没意义”时，你会怎么调整？是停下来，还是重新规划？"}, {"en": "When your schedule is packed, how do you stay clear-headed and avoid just being pushed around by tasks?", "zh": "在你最忙的时候，你会如何保持清醒、避免被任务推着走？"}]

topics.title: Practicing Long-Term Thinking in Life
topics.titleZh: 寻找生活中的长期主义
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your life, what’s something that doesn’t show results right away but will definitely pay off in the long run? How do you manage to stick with it?", "zh": "在你的生活里，有什么事情是“短期看不到效果，但长期一定有回报”的？你是怎么坚持的？"}, {"en": "In today’s world where everyone wants quick results, what do you think is the hardest part about long-term thinking?", "zh": "你觉得在当下这个“追求即时反馈”的时代，长期主义最难的部分是什么？"}, {"en": "When you’re working on something long-term, how do you usually keep yourself motivated?", "zh": "当你坚持一件长期事情时，通常怎么让自己保持动力？"}, {"en": "Do you think long-term thinking conflicts with “living in the moment”? How do you find a balance between the two?", "zh": "你觉得长期主义和“享受当下”之间有没有冲突？你会怎么找到平衡？"}]

topics.title: Perfectionism
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think you’re a perfectionist? In what ways does it show in your life?", "zh": "你觉得自己是完美主义者吗？具体表现在哪些方面？"}, {"en": "In your opinion, what’s the difference between “doing something well” and “making it perfect”? How does this difference show up in your work or daily life?", "zh": "在你看来，“做好”和“做到完美”之间有什么差别？这些差别在工作和生活中，有哪些具体的表现？"}, {"en": "Have you ever delayed or struggled with something just because you wanted it to be perfect? How did that affect your plans?", "zh": "你有因为“想把事情做到完美”而拖延或纠结过吗？对你的计划会产生什么影响？"}, {"en": "Do you see perfectionism more as a source of motivation or pressure? If you wanted to reduce the stress that comes from perfectionism, where would you start?", "zh": "你觉得完美主义更多是动力还是压力？如果你想降低完美主义带来的压力，你会从哪一步开始调整？"}]

topics.title: Boosting Efficiency
topics.questions: [{"en": "When do you usually feel the most productive? What is it about that time of day that helps you stay focused or motivated?", "zh": "你觉得自己效率最高的时段通常是什么时候？那段时间有什么特点，让你能更专注或更有动力？"}, {"en": "When you notice your efficiency dropping, what do you usually do to get your attention back? Why do these methods work for you?", "zh": "当你发现自己效率很低时，你通常会用什么方法让注意力提升？这些方法为什么对你有效？"}, {"en": "What habits or tools have made the biggest difference in your long-term productivity? How have they changed the way you work or live?", "zh": "你认为什么习惯或工具让你的长期效率提升最明显？它改变了你的哪些行为方式？"}, {"en": "Do you think managing your energy and mindset is the foundation of being efficient? How do you see the relationship between emotions, physical condition, and focus?", "zh": "提高效率的前提是管理好精力和心态吗？你觉得情绪、身体状态和专注力之间的关系是怎样的？"}]

topics.title: Filtering Information
topics.questions: [{"en": "In this age of information overload, how do you usually decide whether a piece of information is trustworthy or worth digging into? What’s the most important standard you rely on?", "zh": "在信息量爆炸的时代，你通常如何判断一条信息是否值得相信或继续深入？你最看重的判断标准是什么？"}, {"en": "When there’s too much information and too many choices, what kinds of information do you filter out first? Why are those things “not important” to you?", "zh": "当资讯太多、选择太杂时，你会优先过滤掉哪类信息？为什么这些信息对你来说“不重要”？"}, {"en": "When you come across conflicting information, how do you usually deal with it? Do you trust your instincts, rely on authoritative sources, or spend time checking the facts yourself?", "zh": "当你遇到相互矛盾的信息时，你通常会如何处理？更信任自己的直觉、权威来源，还是会花时间查证？"}, {"en": "Do you think people in the future will need the ability to “find information” more, or the ability to “filter information” more? Why?", "zh": "你觉得未来人们更需要“获取信息的能力”还是“筛选信息的能力”？为什么？"}]

topics.title: Emotional Stability
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your opinion, what are the key traits of someone who has “emotional stability”? Is it about reacting less, reacting more slowly, or being able to bounce back quickly after emotional ups and downs?", "zh": "在你看来，一个人“情绪稳定”的核心特征是什么？是反应慢、反应少，还是能在情绪波动后快速恢复？"}, {"en": "Do you think emotional stability is an inborn personality trait, or something we can develop through practice? Why?", "zh": "你觉得情绪稳定是与生俱来的性格，还是可以通过后天训练获得的能力？为什么？"}, {"en": "When you’re emotionally unstable, what kinds of things trigger you the most? And what do those triggers reveal about your needs or insecurities?", "zh": "当你情绪不稳定时，最容易被什么事情触发？这些触发点背后反映了你的哪些需求或不安全感？"}, {"en": "In close relationships (like with family, partners, or friends), in what ways do you think emotional stability affects the quality of the relationship?", "zh": "在重要关系中（如家人、伴侣、朋友），你觉得“情绪稳定”对关系质量的影响主要体现在哪些方面？"}, {"en": "Where do you think the line is between “being emotionally stable” and “suppressing your emotions”? How can we avoid being controlled by our emotions while still being honest about how we feel?", "zh": "你认为追求情绪稳定和“压抑情绪”之间的界限在哪里？怎样做到既不被情绪牵着走，又不把真实情绪藏起来？"}]

topics.title: Paying for Knowledge
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think about the idea of “paying for knowledge”? Do you see it as a good way to promote learning, or more like a marketing trick?", "zh": "你怎么看待“知识付费”这种现象？你觉得它是促进学习的方式，还是一种营销手段？"}, {"en": "Have you ever paid for a course or skill training? Did you feel it was worth it in the end?", "zh": "你有没有为知识或技能付过费？那次经历让你觉得值不值？"}, {"en": "Many people buy online courses but never finish them. Why do you think that happens — poor course quality, lack of motivation, or ineffective learning methods?", "zh": "现在很多人花钱买课程却学不下去，你觉得问题出在哪——课程质量、个人动力，还是学习方式？"}, {"en": "If you could recommend one topic or course that’s worth paying for, what would it be, and why?", "zh": "如果你要推荐一个值得付费学习的课程或领域，你会选什么？为什么？"}]

topics.title: Emotional Value
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think “emotional value” means? In your daily life, what kind of people or behaviors make you feel emotionally supported or happy?", "zh": "你认为“情绪价值”是什么意思？在生活中，什么样的人或行为能给你带来情绪价值？"}, {"en": "Do you think you’re someone who can bring emotional value to others? How do you usually do that?", "zh": "你觉得自己是一个能给别人提供情绪价值的人吗？通常是通过什么方式？"}, {"en": "In close relationships or friendships, which do you think matters more—emotional support or material help? And when you’re feeling down, do you prefer someone to comfort you, keep you company, or give you practical advice?", "zh": "在亲密关系或友情中，你觉得情绪价值和物质支持哪个更重要？为什么？ 当你情绪低落时，你更希望别人安慰你、陪伴你，还是给你实际的建议？"}, {"en": "Do you think offering emotional support can be exhausting sometimes? How can we care for others while also taking good care of our own emotions?", "zh": "你认为提供情绪价值会让人感到疲惫吗？怎样才能在关心他人的同时，也照顾好自己的情绪？"}]

topics.title: Personal Financial Management
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you usually spend most of your money on? Do you keep track of your income and expenses? How does that help you—or sometimes bother you?", "zh": "你的金钱支出一般都花费在了哪些方面？平时会不会记录自己的收支？这样做对你有什么帮助或困扰？"}, {"en": "Some people think we should spend more when we’re young to enjoy life, while others believe it’s better to start saving and investing early. Which idea do you agree with more, and why?", "zh": "有人认为“年轻时应该多花钱体验生活”，也有人觉得“理财要趁早”，你更认同哪种观点？为什么？"}, {"en": "How do you usually decide whether something is “worth” spending money on? Have you ever regretted—or felt glad about—a purchase afterward?", "zh": "你通常是怎么决定一笔支出是否“值得”的？有没有过花完钱后感到后悔或庆幸的经历？"}, {"en": "When you face financial risks or feel anxious about money, how do you usually calm yourself down or make decisions?", "zh": "当面对投资风险或金钱焦虑时，你通常会如何调整自己的心态或做出决定？"}]

topics.title: The Impact of Short Videos on Life
topics.questions: [{"en": "How much time do you usually spend watching short videos every day? Do those moments bring you relaxation and happiness, or more feelings of emptiness and anxiety?", "zh": "你每天大概花多少时间刷短视频？这些时间带给你的是放松、快乐，还是更多的空虚和焦虑？"}, {"en": "Nowadays, many people get to know the world or learn new things through short videos. Do you think this way is better than traditional reading or in-depth learning?", "zh": "现在很多人通过短视频了解世界、学习知识，你认为这种方式比传统阅读或深度学习更好吗？"}, {"en": "Short video platforms keep recommending content you like through their algorithms. Do you see that as a “thoughtful service” or a kind of “invisible control”?", "zh": "短视频平台的算法会不断推荐你喜欢的内容，你觉得这是一种“贴心服务”，还是一种“无形的操控”？"}, {"en": "Have you ever tried to cut down your short video time? How did it go? Do you think there’s a better way to balance entertainment and personal growth?", "zh": "你有没有尝试过减少刷短视频的时间？效果如何？你觉得有没有更好的方式平衡娱乐与自我成长？"}]

topics.title: Daily Routine
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you usually keep a regular routine? Have you ever tried going to bed early and getting up early? How did it go? Do you think the saying “early risers are more disciplined” is true?", "zh": "你平时的作息规律吗？有没有尝试过早睡早起？结果怎么样？你觉得“早起的人更自律”这种说法对吗？"}, {"en": "When your work or studies mess up your sleep schedule, how do you usually adjust? Does it affect your mood and productivity?", "zh": "当工作或学习打乱了你的作息时，你通常怎么调整？会不会影响你的心情和效率？"}, {"en": "Nowadays, many people like staying up late—watching shows, playing games, or working overtime. Do you think staying up late is a way to relax, or is it actually harmful to yourself?", "zh": "现在很多人喜欢熬夜，比如追剧、打游戏或加班。你觉得熬夜是放松的一种方式，还是对自己的一种伤害？"}, {"en": "In real life, it’s hard to keep a regular schedule. Where do you think the main problem lies—time management, work pressure, or self-discipline? What do you think is the best way to build healthy habits?", "zh": "在现实生活中，想保持规律的作息很难。你觉得问题主要出在哪——时间管理、工作压力，还是意志力？应该怎样养成健康的作息习惯"}]

topics.title: Emotion vs. Rational
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think you’re more of an emotional person or a rational one? Can you give a small example to show that?", "zh": "你觉得自己更像是一个感性的人，还是理性的人？有没有什么小例子能说明？"}, {"en": "When you make decisions in the heat of the moment, do you often regret them later? Do you think being emotional at that time was really a mistake?", "zh": "当你在情绪激动时做出的决定，事后会后悔吗？你觉得那时的“感性”有错吗？"}, {"en": "What do you think a person who’s “too rational” might miss out on in life? And what kind of troubles might someone who’s “too emotional” easily fall into?", "zh": "你认为一个“过于理性”的人，会错过生活中的哪些东西？而一个“太感性”的人，又容易陷入什么困境？"}, {"en": "If you had to sum it up in one sentence, would you like to become a bit more emotional or more rational in the future? Why?", "zh": "如果用一句话来总结，你希望自己今后更“感性”一点，还是更“理性”一点？为什么？"}]

topics.title: Boundaries and Intimacy
topics.titleZh: 边界感 与  亲密感
topics.questions: [{"en": "In a friendship or romantic relationship, do you prefer staying in touch every day, or having some personal space?", "zh": "在朋友或恋人关系中，你会喜欢每天联系，还是各自有空间？"}, {"en": "When someone makes you feel uncomfortable — for example, by asking too many personal questions or interfering with your choices — how do you usually handle it?", "zh": "当别人让你不太舒服（比如问太多私事或干涉你的选择）时，你通常会怎么处理？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the most important thing for maintaining a comfortable and healthy relationship with others?", "zh": "你觉得一个人要想和别人保持舒服的关系，最重要的是什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think “closeness” and “boundaries” conflict with each other? Is it possible to stay close to someone while still keeping healthy boundaries?", "zh": "你觉得“亲密”与“有边界”之间真的会冲突吗？有没有可能在保持边界的同时，也能让关系更亲近？"}]

topics.title: The Meaning of Travel
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you like traveling? What kind of travel do you prefer — going solo, traveling with friends, or joining a tour group?", "zh": "你平时喜欢旅行吗？你最喜欢的旅行方式是什么——独自出发、和朋友一起，还是跟团？"}, {"en": "Has there ever been a trip that changed the way you see life or yourself? What made that experience special?", "zh": "有没有一次旅行让你对生活或自己产生了新的认识？是什么让它与众不同？"}, {"en": "Do you prefer a well-planned trip or a spontaneous one where you just go with the flow? Why?", "zh": "你更喜欢“计划好一切”的旅行，还是“随性走走看看”的旅行？为什么？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the real meaning of travel — to relax, to broaden your horizons, or to escape from reality for a while?", "zh": "你觉得旅行的意义是什么？放松、增长见识、还是逃离现实？"}]

topics.title: How Was Your National Day Holiday?
topics.questions: [{"en": "How did you spend your National Day holiday? Did anything special or memorable happen?", "zh": "你的国庆假期是怎么度过的？有没有发生什么让你印象深刻的事情？"}, {"en": "Do you prefer holidays where you can just relax at home, or ones where you travel and explore? Why?", "zh": "你更喜欢“在家休息”还是“外出旅行”这种类型的假期？为什么？"}, {"en": "After the holiday, did you find it hard to get back into work or study mode? How do you usually readjust yourself?", "zh": "假期结束后，你有没有出现“收心难”的感觉？你一般怎么调整回工作或学习状态？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the true meaning of a holiday — just to relax, or also to recharge and gain new perspectives?", "zh": "你觉得假期的意义是什么？只是放松一下，还是也能让人获得新的思考和能量？"}]

topics.title: Finding Happiness in Daily Life
topics.titleZh: 发现日常生活中的幸福
topics.questions: [{"en": "Has anything small made you really happy recently? And when things don’t go well, how do you usually relax or bring yourself back into a good mood?", "zh": "最近有没有什么小事让你觉得很开心？你平时遇到不顺的时候，会通过什么方式让自己放松、找回好心情？"}, {"en": "Out of food, music, exercise, or chatting with others, which one gives you the strongest feeling of happiness?", "zh": "你觉得美食、音乐、运动、聊天，这些日常的小事情里，哪一个最能给你带来幸福感？"}, {"en": "In your busy life, do you have any “little happy habits” that always make you feel better?", "zh": "在忙碌的生活中，你有没有属于自己的“快乐小习惯”？"}, {"en": "If you were to give someone advice on how to notice happiness more easily in daily life, what would you say?", "zh": "如果让你给别人一个建议，如何更容易在日常里发现幸福，你会说什么？"}]

topics.title: How to Build Knowledge More Effectively
topics.questions: [{"en": "What’s your main way of gaining knowledge in daily life? (For example, reading books, using the internet, taking courses, or hands-on practice.) Which way do you feel works best for you?", "zh": "你平时获取知识的主要途径是什么？（比如读书、网络、课程、实践），你觉得哪种方式最适合你？"}, {"en": "In today’s information overload, how can we make sure that knowledge isn’t just something we’ve “seen,” but something we actually absorb and remember?", "zh": "在信息爆炸的时代，如何避免“知识只是看过”而不是“真正吸收并记住”？"}, {"en": "Do you think building knowledge is more about breadth (exploring many areas) or depth (focusing on one field)? Why?", "zh": "你觉得知识积累更需要“广度”（多方面涉猎）还是“深度”（专注一个领域）？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think sharing knowledge and exchanging ideas is also a way of building knowledge? Why do some people seem to learn even better the more they share?", "zh": "你认为分享知识和交流是否也是一种积累？为什么有些人越分享越能学得更好？"}]

topics.title: Planning Ahead vs. Going with the Flow
topics.titleZh: 喜欢做规划 vs 随性自由
topics.questions: [{"en": "In life, do you prefer making plans in advance or just going with the flow? What kind of benefits or problems has this habit brought you?", "zh": "在生活中，你更喜欢提前做规划，还是随心而行？你觉得这种习惯对你带来了什么好处或麻烦？"}, {"en": "When it comes to traveling, would you rather have a completely flexible trip or a well-planned itinerary? Why?", "zh": "如果旅行时，行程完全随性和全程计划周密，你会更倾向哪一种？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think planning gives you a stronger sense of control, or does it sometimes feel like it limits your freedom? Have you ever had an experience that really shaped your view? Do you feel planning makes you more at ease, or a bit tied down?", "zh": "你觉得做规划会让生活更有掌控感，还是限制了自由？有没有让你印象深刻的经历？你觉得做规划能让你更安心，还是会让你觉得有点束缚？"}, {"en": "If you spent one week living completely by plan and another week living completely spontaneously, how do you think the experiences would feel different?", "zh": "如果完全随性和完全按计划各自生活一周，你觉得会有什么不同的感受？"}]

topics.title: Multitasking — Productive or Distracting?
topics.titleZh: 同时处理多任务：高效还是分心？
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your daily study or work, do you usually prefer focusing on one task at a time, or handling multiple tasks simultaneously?", "zh": "在日常学习或工作中，你更习惯一次专注完成一件事，还是同时处理多项任务？"}, {"en": "Some people believe multitasking is a must-have skill in today’s world, while others think staying focused is more important. Which view do you agree with, and why?", "zh": "有些人认为“多线程处理”是现代社会的必备能力，也有人觉得“专注”更重要。 你更认同哪种观点？"}, {"en": "When you’re juggling several tasks and face time conflicts or mental overload, how do you usually decide what to prioritize? Do you think your way of making decisions is effective, or have you thought about improving it?", "zh": "当你在处理多个任务时，遇到时间冲突或精力分散的情况，你通常怎么决定优先级？ 你觉得自己的决策方式合理吗？有没有想过优化它？"}, {"en": "Have you ever tried any methods to improve your multitasking skills, such as time management tools, the Pomodoro technique, or to-do lists? Which methods have worked well for you, and which haven’t? Why do you think that is?", "zh": "你有没有尝试过一些提升多任务处理能力的方法，比如时间管理工具、番茄工作法、待办清单等？ 哪些方法对你有效，哪些无效？你觉得原因是什么？"}]

topics.title: Ways to Relax
topics.questions: [{"en": "When you’re feeling stressed or down, what’s your go-to way to relax? Why do you choose this method, and do you think it’s the most effective for you?", "zh": "当你感到压力很大或心情低落时，你最常用的放松方式是什么？为什么选择这种方式？它对你来说最有效吗？"}, {"en": "Do you find it easier to relax when you’re alone or when you’re with others? Why? Have you noticed any differences depending on the situation?", "zh": "你觉得独处的时候更容易放松，还是和别人一起更容易放松？为什么？你有没有在不同场合下的不同感受？"}, {"en": "Do you usually set aside specific time just to relax, or do you prefer to finish your tasks first and then find something fun to unwind? Which approach works better for you?", "zh": "你平时会为了“放松”而专门留出时间吗？还是更倾向于完成任务后，顺便找点娱乐来休息？你觉得哪种方式更适合自己？"}, {"en": "Is there a relaxation method you’ve always wanted to try but haven’t started yet — like traveling, yoga, meditation, painting, or crafting? What has stopped you from trying it?", "zh": "有没有一种放松方式，你很想尝试但还没有开始？比如旅行、瑜伽、冥想、画画、做手工等，是什么原因让你一直没尝试？"}]

topics.title: Simple Lifestyle
topics.questions: [{"en": "When you think about a “simple life,” do you see it as spending less money, wanting fewer things, or just having fewer worries? How would you personally define it?", "zh": "你觉得“简单的生活”是少花钱、少欲望，还是让自己少被事情困扰？你会怎么定义？"}, {"en": "If you had to choose, would you prefer a life that’s materially rich but complicated, or ordinary but simple? Why?", "zh": "如果让你选择，你更想要“物质丰富但复杂”的生活，还是“物质普通但简单”的生活？为什么？"}, {"en": "What small changes have you made in your daily life to make things feel easier, lighter, or less stressful?", "zh": "在日常生活中，你做过哪些小改变，让自己的生活变得更简单、更轻松？"}, {"en": "In your opinion, what’s the difference between living simply and just being lazy or giving up? Do you ever worry about people misunderstanding your choice?", "zh": "你觉得简单的生活和偷懒、躺平有什么区别？你会担心别人误解你的选择吗？"}]

topics.title: Delayed Gratification
topics.questions: [{"en": "In today’s fast-paced world, do you think sticking to delayed gratification is becoming harder? In what situations would you insist on it, and when would you choose to give in?", "zh": "你觉得在当下快节奏的生活里，坚持“延迟满足”是不是一件越来越难的事？你会在什么场景下坚持，什么场景下妥协？"}, {"en": "Have you ever experienced long-term rewards in your studies or work because you chose delayed gratification? How did that experience shape your mindset?", "zh": "在学习或工作中，你有没有因为选择延迟满足而收获长期回报的经历？这种经验对你的心态有怎样的影响？"}, {"en": "Do you think delayed gratification and enjoying the present are always in conflict? Or is it possible to strike a balance between the two?", "zh": "你认为延迟满足和“享受当下”之间一定是矛盾的吗？有没有可能两者同时兼顾？"}, {"en": "Some people see delayed gratification as a form of self-discipline, while others think it’s more like suppressing your needs. Which view do you agree with, and why?", "zh": "有些人觉得延迟满足是一种“自律”，有些人觉得是“压抑需求”，你更认同哪一种看法？为什么？"}]

topics.title: Insights from Learning English Recently
topics.questions: [{"en": "While learning English lately, what methods have worked best for you? Why do you think these methods suit you?", "zh": "最近在学习英语的过程中，你发现了哪些对自己最有效的学习方法？你认为这些方法为什么适合你？"}, {"en": "Have you ever hit a plateau in your English learning where you felt stuck? How did you try to overcome it?", "zh": "在英语学习中，你遇到过让自己感到停滞不前的瓶颈吗？你是如何尝试突破这种困境的？"}, {"en": "When it comes to learning English, which do you think matters more: efficiency or consistency? If you had to choose only one, which would you pick, and why?", "zh": "你觉得“效率”和“坚持”在学习英语中哪个更重要？如果只能选一个，你会怎么选择，为什么？"}, {"en": "Could you share some learning methods or resources that you’ve found really helpful for improving your English?", "zh": "分享或介绍一下你认为不错的学习英语的方法或学习资源"}]

topics.title: Sense of Control
topics.questions: [{"en": "How important is having a sense of control to you? What do you usually do to feel more in control?", "zh": "你觉得掌控感对你来说重要吗？你会采取什么方式让自己获得更多的掌控感？"}, {"en": "Have you ever found yourself getting more anxious because you were trying too hard to stay in control?", "zh": "你是否遇到过为了追求掌控感，反而让自己陷入更大焦虑的情况？"}, {"en": "Do you think real control means “managing everything,” or can you still feel stable even when you allow some things to be out of your control?", "zh": "你觉得真正的掌控感是“控制一切”，还是“允许一部分失控”也能保持内心的稳定？"}, {"en": "In close relationships or social situations, how do you balance wanting control with respecting other people’s freedom?", "zh": "在亲密关系或社交中，你如何平衡“想掌控局面”和“尊重他人自由”之间的界限？"}]

topics.title: Hobbies
topics.questions: [{"en": "What hobbies do you have? Has any hobby ever helped you see yourself in a new light or even changed some part of your life?", "zh": "你有哪些自己的兴趣爱好？有没有因为一个兴趣而重新认识自己，或者改变了生活的某种状态？"}, {"en": "Do you think hobbies should stay as “pure fun,” or can they be developed into a side hustle or even a career?", "zh": "你觉得兴趣爱好应该是“纯粹的快乐”，还是可以发展成副业甚至事业？"}, {"en": "If your current hobby is totally different from those of your friends or family, would you stick with it or adjust for the sake of socializing?", "zh": "如果你现在的兴趣和朋友、家人的兴趣完全不同，你会选择坚持，还是会为了社交而调整？"}, {"en": "Do you think hobbies can, in some way, reflect a person’s personality and values?", "zh": "兴趣爱好在某种程度上能体现一个人的性格和价值观吗？"}]

topics.title: A Sense of Ritual
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think having a sense of ritual is a must-have in life, or just a nice little extra?", "zh": "你觉得仪式感是生活的必需品，还是一种可有可无的点缀？"}, {"en": "On busy or stressful days, do rituals really help change your mood or state of mind?", "zh": "在忙碌或压力大的日子里，仪式感是否真的能改变情绪和状态？"}, {"en": "What’s the most memorable “ritual” you’ve ever experienced? Did it bring you joy, a sense of being touched, or something else?", "zh": "你最难忘的一次“仪式感”体验是什么？它带给你的是快乐、感动，还是别的东西？"}, {"en": "As you’ve grown older, has your understanding of “ritual” changed?", "zh": "随着年龄增长，你对“仪式感”的理解有没有发生变化？"}]

topics.title: Talking to My Past Self
topics.questions: [{"en": "If you could say one thing to yourself from five years ago, what would you want to remind or encourage yourself about?", "zh": "如果可以和五年前的自己说一句话，你最想提醒或鼓励的是什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think your five-years-ago self would feel proud of who you are now, or a bit disappointed? Why?", "zh": "你觉得五年前的自己会为现在的你感到骄傲，还是失望？为什么？"}, {"en": "Over the past five years, is there something you once thought was super important but now realize doesn’t really matter anymore?", "zh": "这五年里，有没有什么你当时以为很重要、现在却不再在意的事情？"}, {"en": "If you could take your current skills and experiences back to five years ago, what decisions would you make differently?", "zh": "如果可以把现在的能力、经验带回到五年前，你会做出哪些不同的决定？"}]

topics.title: The Little Joys in Life
topics.questions: [{"en": "When was the last time you felt one of those little moments of happiness? What was it exactly, and why did it feel so special to you?", "zh": "你最近一次感受到“小确幸”的时刻是什么？当时的那个细节，为什么让你觉得特别珍贵？"}, {"en": "Do you think these “little joys” just happen by chance, or can we create them on purpose? Do you have your own personal “formula” for finding them?", "zh": "你觉得“小确幸”是可遇不可求，还是可以主动去“制造”的？你有自己的小确幸“配方”吗？"}, {"en": "How do you see the relationship between life’s little joys and big goals? Are they fuel that keeps us going, or just a way to escape from pressure?", "zh": "你认为“小确幸”和“人生大目标”之间的关系是什么？它是对前进的滋养，还是一种逃避？"}, {"en": "Do you think everyone is capable of noticing and feeling these small moments of happiness? Does it have something to do with a person’s stage in life, personality, or past experiences?", "zh": "你觉得“小确幸”是每个人都能感受到的吗？它和个人的成长阶段、性格、经历有关吗？"}]

topics.title: When You Overthink Things
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever missed out on opportunities because you were overthinking? Looking back, how do you feel about those worries at the time?", "zh": "你有没有因为“想太多”而错过了一些机会？事后你怎么看待当时的顾虑？"}, {"en": "Do you think overthinking comes from being sensitive, cautious, or anxious? In what situations can it be a strength, and when does it become a burden?", "zh": "你觉得“想得太多”是一种敏感、谨慎，还是一种焦虑？在哪些情况下是优势，哪些时候又成了负担？"}, {"en": "Is there someone around you who seems like they never overthink things? How do you feel about their personality or way of living? Do you ever wish you were more like that?", "zh": "在你身边，有没有人似乎从不“想太多”？你怎么看待这种性格或生活方式？你羡慕吗？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the root cause of overthinking? Is it a lack of security, low self-confidence, or fear of the unknown?", "zh": "你认为“想太多”的根本原因是什么？是缺乏安全感、不自信，还是对未知的恐惧？"}]

topics.title: Following the Crowd or Being Yourself
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever gone along with others just because you were afraid of being left out? Looking back, how do you feel about that choice?", "zh": "你是否有过因为害怕被孤立而选择迎合他人意见的经历？事后你是如何评价那次选择的？"}, {"en": "Does “being yourself” mean you always have to stand out or be different? In your opinion, what are some different ways to be true to yourself?", "zh": "“做自己”是否意味着要时刻坚持与众不同？你认为做自己可以有哪些不同的方式？"}, {"en": "When it comes to big life decisions—like career choices, relationships, or lifestyle—do you usually follow what most people suggest, or do you trust your own judgment more? How do you find a balance between the two?", "zh": "在重大决策上（如职业选择、婚恋、生活方式等），你更倾向于听从多数人的建议，还是跟随自己的判断？你如何权衡这两者？"}, {"en": "Do you think the idea that “what most people choose must be right” makes sense? Based on your own experience, how do you see the relationship between the majority and the truth?", "zh": "“多数人的选择就是正确的”这种观念是否合理？在你的经验中，多数和真理之间的关系是怎样的？"}]

topics.title: Sense of Time & Age Anxiety
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever felt like you’re “running out of time” or that “it’s already too late”? In what situations does that feeling usually come up? How do you deal with it?", "zh": "你是否有过“来不及”或“已经晚了”的感觉？通常是在怎样的情境下？你是怎么调节这种情绪的？"}, {"en": "Do you think the idea that “time goes faster as we get older” is just an illusion, or is it actually true? How do you make sense of this feeling that time is flying?", "zh": "你觉得年龄越大，时间过得越快是一种错觉，还是确有其事？你如何理解这种“时间飞逝”的感受？"}, {"en": "Have you ever felt anxious because your peers had already achieved something and you hadn’t? How did that kind of comparison affect you, and how did you try to handle it?", "zh": "你是否曾因为“同龄人已经……而我还没有”而感到焦虑？这类比较对你造成了什么样的影响？你又是如何调适的？"}, {"en": "What’s your take on the idea that we’re “supposed to hit certain milestones at certain ages”? Do you feel stuck or pressured by some kind of timeline?", "zh": "你怎么看待“每个阶段都该完成什么”的观点？你是否正在被某种“进度表”所困？"}]

topics.title: Familiarity vs. Novelty
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your daily life, do you prefer sticking to familiar environments, or are you more into trying new things all the time? What do you think this says about your personality or what you need?", "zh": "你在生活中更倾向于选择熟悉的环境，还是愿意不断尝试新鲜的事物？这种倾向背后反映了你怎样的性格或需求？"}, {"en": "In long-term relationships—like friendships or romantic ones—how do you think we can keep the warmth of familiarity while still bringing in a sense of freshness? Do you think these two ever conflict?", "zh": "你觉得在长期的人际关系（如友情、亲密关系）中，如何维持熟悉感的温暖与新鲜感的活力？是否存在冲突？"}, {"en": "Have you ever felt bored at work or while studying just because everything felt too familiar? How do you usually bring in something new to keep yourself motivated?", "zh": "在学习或工作中，你是否会因为过于熟悉而感到厌倦？你通常是如何为自己制造新鲜感来保持动力的？"}, {"en": "Have you ever gotten so caught up in chasing new experiences that you overlooked people or things that were already meaningful in your life? How did you eventually realize it?", "zh": "你有没有因为过度追求新鲜感，而忽略了身边原本值得珍惜的事物或人？后来是如何意识到的？"}]

topics.title: Friendship
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you feel like making friends has become harder as an adult? Where do you think this change comes from—is it the fast pace of life, lack of trust, or different needs between people?", "zh": "成年之后，你是否觉得交朋友变得更难了？这种变化来自哪里，是节奏、信任，还是彼此的需求？"}, {"en": "Do you think it’s important to set boundaries in a friendship? What kind of boundaries do you personally hope others will respect?", "zh": "你认为，友情中需要保持“界限感”吗？哪些界限是你希望被尊重的？"}, {"en": "Have you ever been misunderstood by a friend—or misunderstood them? When that happened, did you choose to talk it out, stay silent, or walk away? Why?", "zh": "你经历过“被朋友误解”或“误解朋友”的情况吗？当时你选择了沟通、沉默，还是离开？为什么？"}, {"en": "Have you ever grown apart from a close friend? Was it a slow drift or caused by a specific event? How do you feel about friendships that were once strong but faded over time?", "zh": "你是否有过“走散”的朋友？是自然疏远还是某次事件导致？你怎么看待“曾经很好但后来淡了”的关系？"}]

topics.title: Health
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever realized that some of your habits—like staying up late, sitting for too long, or binge eating—are slowly affecting your health? What has stopped you from changing them right away?", "zh": "你有没有意识到过，自己的某些生活习惯（比如熬夜、久坐、暴饮暴食）其实正在慢慢影响你的健康？是什么让你没有及时改变？"}, {"en": "How do you feel about “body anxiety” and “health anxiety”? Do you think these feelings are genuine reminders to take care of ourselves, or are they more like pressure created by marketing and social standards?", "zh": "你如何看待“身材焦虑”和“健康焦虑”？这些情绪到底是健康的提醒，还是被营销和社会标准操控的结果？"}, {"en": "Do you think mental health is still being overlooked in today’s society? Do you have any specific ways to take care of your own emotional well-being in daily life?", "zh": "你认为现代社会中，心理健康是否被严重忽视了？你在日常生活中有没有照顾自己“情绪免疫力”的具体方式？"}, {"en": "In a fast-paced and high-pressure world, are you actively trying to build “resilience” for yourself? Things like giving yourself downtime, exercising, meditating, or maintaining close relationships—do any of these actually work for you?", "zh": "面对快节奏和高压力的生活环境，你是否在刻意为自己创造“恢复力”？比如留白、运动、冥想、亲密关系等？这些方式对你真的有效吗？"}]

topics.title: How Do You View "Stability" and "Ambition"?
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you lean more toward a stable life, or are you willing to take risks for your ambitions? Has this preference changed as you’ve grown older?", "zh": "你更倾向于追求安稳的生活，还是愿意为了野心冒一定的风险？在你的成长过程中，这种倾向有没有发生过变化？"}, {"en": "Do you think ambition is something everyone should have? In what situations can ambition turn into a burden or a source of stress?", "zh": "你认为“野心”是每个人都应该具备的特质吗？在什么情况下，野心可能变成一种压力或负担？"}, {"en": "Do stability and ambition have to be opposites? Have you ever seen or experienced a time or a person who managed to balance both well?", "zh": "安稳和野心是否一定是对立的？你是否见过或经历过将二者平衡得比较好的人或阶段？"}, {"en": "Do you think your family, social environment, or education has influenced how you view stability and ambition? How much have these factors shaped your own choices?", "zh": "你觉得家庭、社会环境或者教育背景会影响一个人对安稳和野心的追求吗？你个人的选择受这些因素影响多吗？"}]

topics.title: Managing Negative Emotions
topics.questions: [{"en": "When you realize you’re feeling down or stuck in a negative mood, what do you usually do? Do you prefer to distract yourself, express your feelings, or suppress and avoid them? Why?", "zh": "当你意识到自己正处于消极情绪中时，你通常会怎么做？你更倾向于转移注意力、表达情绪，还是压抑和回避？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think staying in a negative emotional state for too long can affect your judgment or behavior? Have you ever made a decision you later regretted because you were emotionally overwhelmed?", "zh": "你是否认为长期的负面情绪会影响一个人的判断力和行为？有没有经历过因为情绪而做出不理性决定的时候？"}, {"en": "When you're under a lot of pressure from work or school, how do you notice and manage your emotions? Do you have any personal habits or methods that really help you feel better?", "zh": "在工作或学习压力大时，你会如何识别和调节自己的情绪状态？有没有一些你亲测有效的方法或习惯？"}, {"en": "Do other people’s emotions affect you? When you’re around someone with a negative vibe, how do you protect your own mood without damaging the relationship?", "zh": "你觉得他人的情绪对你有影响吗？在被他人的负面情绪波及时，你是如何保护自己，同时又不伤害关系的？"}]

topics.title: Taking Initiative
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think is the main reason someone becomes proactive in life or at work? Is it a sense of responsibility, a clear goal, or just personality?", "zh": "你觉得一个人在生活或工作中变得“主动”最关键的动因是什么？是责任感、目标感，还是性格使然？"}, {"en": "Have you ever missed an opportunity because you didn’t take the initiative? How did you reflect on it afterward?", "zh": "你是否有过因为“没有主动”而错失机会的经历？事后你是如何反思这件事的？"}, {"en": "Do you think being too proactive in social situations might make others feel pressured? How do you find the right balance between reaching out and giving people space?", "zh": "你觉得在社交中太主动会不会让人感到有压力？在“主动联系”与“尊重距离”之间，你是如何拿捏分寸的？"}, {"en": "Do you think being proactive is a skill that can be developed? Were there any experiences in your life that helped you become more proactive?", "zh": "你认为“主动”是一种可培养的能力吗？在你的成长过程中，有哪些经历让你变得更主动？"}]

topics.title: Avoidance
topics.questions: [{"en": "Is there something you've been avoiding for a long time? Is it because of fear, a sense of helplessness, or uncertainty about the outcome? What do you think is the real reason behind it?", "zh": "你有没有哪件事一直在逃避？是出于恐惧、无力感，还是对结果的不确定？你觉得这背后真正的原因是什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think avoidance is always a bad thing? Can there be situations where avoiding something is actually a way to protect yourself?", "zh": "你认为“逃避”一定是负面的行为吗？有没有一种情况，逃避其实是一种保护自己的方式？"}, {"en": "In school or at work, when you notice yourself procrastinating or avoiding a certain task, how do you recognize and deal with that avoidance?", "zh": "在学习或工作中，当你发现自己在拖延或不愿面对某个问题时，你是如何觉察和应对这种“逃避”的？"}, {"en": "When you face conflict with others, do you tend to address it directly or avoid it? What do you think are the consequences of avoiding conflict?", "zh": "当你面对人际冲突时，会选择直接沟通还是回避问题？你认为逃避冲突会带来什么后果？"}]

topics.title: Socializing
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think you're good at socializing? In what kinds of social situations do you feel comfortable, and in which ones do you feel stressed?", "zh": "你觉得自己是一个擅长社交的人吗？在什么样的社交场合你会感到自在，什么样的场合又会让你感到压力？"}, {"en": "In your opinion, what’s the difference between meaningful socializing and just having surface-level connections? Which one do you prefer, and why?", "zh": "在你看来，“有效社交”和“泛泛之交”之间有什么区别？你更倾向于哪一种社交方式？为什么？"}, {"en": "Has your way of socializing changed as you’ve grown older or moved through different life stages? For example, have you shifted from seeking excitement to craving deeper connections?", "zh": "随着年龄或阶段的变化，你的社交方式有没有发生过明显的转变？比如从追求热闹转向追求连接感？"}, {"en": "When you’re around strangers or in a new social setting, what do you usually do to break the ice? Have these strategies worked well for you?", "zh": "在面对陌生人或新的社交环境时，你通常会采取什么策略来建立初步联系？这些方法对你来说有效吗？"}]

topics.title: Becoming a High-Energy Person
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your opinion, what are the typical traits of a “high-energy person”?
