What kind of positive impact do they usually have in daily life or at work?", "zh": "在你看来，“高能量的人”有哪些典型特征？他们在生活或职场中会带来怎样的正面影响？"}, {"en": "Do you think being high-energy is something people are born with, or can it be developed over time? If it can be developed, what do you think is the most important factor?", "zh": "你觉得高能量是一种性格天赋，还是可以通过后天培养的状态？如果可以培养，你认为最关键的因素是什么？"}, {"en": "When you spend time with high-energy people, do you feel uplifted or do they make you feel pressured or tired? Do you think your reaction depends on your own state of mind?", "zh": "当你和“高能量的人”相处时，是否会受到正向影响，还是反而感到压力或疲惫？这种反应与你自身的状态有关系吗？"}, {"en": "When you’re feeling down or drained, how do you recharge yourself? Are there any go-to methods that help you get back into a high-energy state?", "zh": "在低谷或疲惫的时候，你会如何给自己“充电”？有没有什么方法让你重新找回高能量的状态？"}]

topics.title: The concept of consumption
topics.questions: [{"en": "How do you define a “worthwhile” purchase? Is it something that’s useful and practical, or something that brings emotional satisfaction? Is there one thing you’ve bought that still feels totally worth it?", "zh": "你如何界定“值得”的消费？是带来实用价值的，还是带来情绪满足的？有没有你至今仍觉得“非常值得”的一次消费？"}, {"en": "Have you ever made a purchase that wasn’t very rational because of ads, social media, or pressure from friends? Looking back, how do you feel about that decision now?", "zh": "在广告、社交媒体和同龄人影响下，你是否曾做出过“不是很理性的消费决策”？事后你是如何看待这些经历的？"}, {"en": "Has your spending mindset changed over time? For example, have you gone from focusing on cost-effectiveness to being willing to pay for experiences? What triggered that shift?", "zh": "你有没有经历过消费观念的变化？比如从“重视性价比”到“愿意为体验买单”，这种转变是由什么促成的？"}, {"en": "Do you try to build a habit of delaying gratification when it comes to spending? How do you balance your material desires with self-control?", "zh": "你是否会刻意培养“延迟满足”的消费习惯？在物质需求和自我控制之间，你如何寻找平衡点？"}]

topics.title: Listening to Others' Opinions
topics.questions: [{"en": "When it comes to making important decisions, do you tend to follow your own heart or consider other people’s advice? Is there an experience that stands out in your memory?", "zh": "在面对重要决策时，你更倾向于听从内心的声音，还是参考他人的意见？有没有哪次经历让你印象深刻？"}, {"en": "When your own thoughts conflict with other people’s expectations, how do you usually deal with it? Do you compromise, stick to your decision, or avoid the situation? Why?", "zh": "当内心的想法和外界的期待相冲突时，你通常怎么处理这种冲突？你会妥协、坚持，还是逃避？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think your inner voice is always \"right\"? Is outside input always just a distraction? How do you tell which voices are truly helpful to you?", "zh": "你认为内心的声音是否总是“正确”的？外界的声音是否总是“干扰”？该如何区分哪些声音是真正对自己有帮助的？"}, {"en": "Have you ever made a choice just to meet someone else’s expectations? How did you convince yourself at the time? Did you ever regret it later?", "zh": "你是否曾为了迎合他人的期待而做出选择？当时你是怎么说服自己的？事后有后悔过吗？"}]

topics.title: Being a Sensitive Person
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever found yourself overthinking something someone said, even if it wasn’t meant in a bad way, and it ended up affecting your mood? How do you usually deal with those emotions?", "zh": "你是否曾因为别人无意中的一句话而反复揣测，甚至影响心情？你是怎么调整自己的情绪的？"}, {"en": "Do you see sensitivity as a personal weakness, or do you think it can be a strength—like being more observant or empathetic?", "zh": "在你看来，敏感是一种性格上的弱点，还是可以成为观察入微和共情力强的优点？"}, {"en": "Have you ever felt misunderstood or labeled as someone who \"overthinks\" just because you’re more sensitive? How do you handle that kind of misunderstanding?", "zh": "你有没有因为“太敏感”而在关系中感到不被理解或被贴上“想太多”的标签？你是如何面对这种误解的？"}, {"en": "When you realize your sensitivity might be affecting your judgment or relationships, do you try to hold it back, or do you work on accepting and understanding it? Why?", "zh": "当你意识到自己的“敏感”可能影响到判断或人际关系时，你会主动压抑它，还是努力去理解和接纳它？为什么？"}]

topics.title: The State of Being Busy
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think your busyness feels like meaningful productivity, or more like chaotic overload? How do you decide whether your busy schedule is truly worth it?", "zh": "你认为自己的忙碌是“有目的的充实”，还是“被动的混乱”？你是如何判断忙碌是否值得的？"}, {"en": "Have you ever felt so busy that you could barely catch your breath? How did that level of busyness affect your mood and quality of life?", "zh": "你有没有过“忙得喘不过气”的时候？那种状态对你的情绪和生活质量造成了怎样的影响？"}, {"en": "When you realize you're “too busy” but can’t seem to slow down, how do you try to reset your pace? What methods have you used to feel more in control of your life again?", "zh": "当你意识到自己“太忙了”却停不下来时，你会如何调整自己的节奏？你尝试过什么方法来恢复生活的掌控感？"}, {"en": "What’s the relationship between being busy and being efficient, in your view? Do you think it’s possible to stay productive without feeling overwhelmed? What’s your personal experience with that?", "zh": "你认为“忙碌”和“高效”之间是什么关系？有没有可能既不焦虑又能保持高效的节奏？你自己的经验是什么？"}]

topics.title: The Anxiety of Feeling Stuck
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever felt like everyone else is moving forward while you're stuck in the same place? How did that feeling affect your daily life at the time?", "zh": "你是否经历过“感觉别人都在进步，只有自己停滞不前”的阶段？当时这种感觉是如何影响你的日常生活的？"}, {"en": "Do you think the feeling of being stuck comes more from reality or from comparing yourself to others? How do you tell if you're truly not making progress or just not being noticed?", "zh": "你认为“原地踏步”的感觉更多来自客观现实，还是主观比较？你怎么判断自己的状态是真停滞还是只是“没被看见”？"}, {"en": "When anxiety hits, how do you usually cope? Do you push yourself to break through it, or do you give yourself a break and slow down? Which approach works better for you?", "zh": "在焦虑感袭来时，你通常会怎么处理？是倾向于激励自己突破，还是选择接受并缓一缓？哪种方式对你更有效？"}, {"en": "What do you think of the saying “It’s okay to go slow”? In today’s fast-paced world, do you find this mindset helpful, or does it make you feel even more anxious—or maybe freer?", "zh": "你如何看待“慢一点也没关系”的说法？在快节奏的社会中，这种想法是否现实？是否会让你更焦虑或更自由？"}]

topics.title: The Moment of "Saving Face"
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever made a decision that went against your true feelings just to save face? Looking back, how do you feel about that choice?", "zh": "你是否有过“为了面子”做出违背本意的决定？事后你怎么看待这样的选择？"}, {"en": "In your opinion, is “saving face” more of an emotion, a skill, or a cultural influence? Why?", "zh": "在你看来，“要面子”是一种情绪、一种能力，还是一种文化影响？为什么？"}, {"en": "In the workplace, when “saving face” for others conflicts with sticking to your principles, how do you usually choose?", "zh": "在职场中，“给面子”和“讲原则”有冲突时，你通常会怎么取舍？"}, {"en": "How do you see the balance between “caring about your face” and being shamelessly bold? Do you think this balance is a sign of emotional intelligence?", "zh": "你怎么看待“适度要面子”和“厚脸皮之间”的平衡？这是否是一种情商？"}]

topics.title: Stability vs. Change – What Kind of Life Do You Prefer?
topics.titleZh: 稳定 vs. 变化：你更向往哪种生活？
topics.questions: [{"en": "What kind of life do you think “stability” and “change” each represent? How do they make you feel?", "zh": "你认为“稳定”和“变化”各自代表了什么样的生活状态？它们分别给你带来哪些感受？"}, {"en": "Have you ever gone through a phase where you shifted from seeking stability to actively embracing change—or the other way around? What made you change your mindset?", "zh": "你是否经历过从“追求稳定”转向“主动求变”，或反过来的阶段？促使你改变的原因是什么？"}, {"en": "When it comes to work, relationships, or where you live, do you make similar choices about stability or change? Why might your preferences differ in these areas?", "zh": "在工作、感情、居住地等方面，你对于“稳定”与“变化”的选择是否一致？为何有差异？"}, {"en": "Do you think choosing between stability and change is more about your personality or the environment you’re in? What factors influence your decision the most?", "zh": "你觉得选择“稳定”或“变化”的背后，是性格决定多一些，还是环境影响更多？哪些因素会影响你的选择？"}]

topics.title: Reason or Intuition
topics.questions: [{"en": "When it comes to the important decisions you’ve made in the past, do you think reason or intuition played a bigger role? Were you happy with the outcome?", "zh": "在你过去的重要决定中，理性分析和直觉判断哪个起了更大作用？结果让你满意吗？"}, {"en": "Do you think intuition comes from experience, or is it more driven by emotion? Do you usually trust your gut feeling?", "zh": "你认为直觉是一种经验的积累，还是一种情绪驱动？你会信任它吗？"}, {"en": "Have you ever regretted a decision because you were too rational or relied only on intuition? What did you learn from that experience?", "zh": "你有没有因为过度理性或完全凭直觉而后悔的决定？你从中学到了什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think different kinds of decisions—like career planning, relationships, or everyday choices—require different amounts of logic and intuition? Why or why not?", "zh": "你认为不同类型的决策（如职业规划、人际关系、日常选择）是否需要不同程度的理性与直觉？为什么？"}]

topics.title: The Person I Want to Be
topics.questions: [{"en": "What does your ideal life look like? How different is it from your current life? What do you think is the key to making it happen?", "zh": "你理想中的生活状态是什么样的？它和你现在的生活有什么差距？你觉得实现它的关键是什么"}, {"en": "Have you ever really admired a certain type of person? What qualities do they have that reflect the person you want to become?", "zh": "你有没有特别羡慕过某一类人？他们的哪些特质构成了你“想成为的样子”？"}, {"en": "Have you ever redefined what kind of person you want to be? Was it because reality changed you, or because your vision became clearer? Did this change make you feel disappointed or more at peace?", "zh": "你是否曾重新定义过“自己想成为的样子”？是被现实打磨了，还是更清晰了？这种改变让你感到失落，还是释然？"}, {"en": "Have you ever drifted away from your true self just to meet other people’s expectations? How did you realize it, and how did you adjust?", "zh": "你有没有因为迎合他人的期待而偏离了“自己想成为的样子”？你是怎么发现并调整的？"}]

topics.title: When to Cut Your Losses
topics.questions: [{"en": "When you’ve put a lot of time and energy into something but it’s not working out, are you more likely to push through or consider cutting your losses? Why?", "zh": "面对一件投入了很多精力但效果不理想的事情，你更倾向于坚持到底，还是考虑及时止损？为什么？"}, {"en": "In what situations do you think “giving up” isn’t a sign of weakness, but actually a mature decision? Can you share an example?", "zh": "在什么情况下你会觉得“放弃”并不是逃避，而是一种成熟的选择？你能举个例子吗？"}, {"en": "What signs do you think can help us decide whether it’s time to stop? Have you learned any lessons from past experiences?", "zh": "你觉得哪些信号可以帮助我们判断一件事是否该“止损”？有没有什么经验教训？"}, {"en": "Since cutting your losses often means walking away from what you’ve already invested, how do you weigh the current “loss” against the possible gains in the future?", "zh": "“及时止损”有时意味着放弃当前的投入，那你会如何评估“损失”和“未来可能的收益”之间的关系？"}]

topics.title: When You Just Don’t Feel Like Trying
topics.questions: [{"en": "When you feel like “I just don’t want to try today,” how do you usually deal with it? Do you suppress the feeling, try to distract yourself, or just go with it? In those low-energy moments, do you feel you need encouragement, someone to be there with you, or to be alone? Why?", "zh": "当你有“今天不想努力”的情绪时，你会如何应对？压抑、转移、还是顺从它？面对“今天不想努力”的低谷时刻，你更需要的是鼓励、陪伴，还是一个人独处？为什么？"}, {"en": "Has there ever been a time when you allowed yourself not to try—and it unexpectedly gave you new strength or a fresh start?", "zh": "有没有哪一刻，你允许自己“今天不努力”，但因此获得了新的力量或转机？"}, {"en": "Have you ever felt guilty or ashamed for not wanting to try? Do you think that feeling is reasonable?", "zh": "你有没有因为“今天不想努力”的状态，而对自己感到愧疚或自责？这种情绪合理吗？"}, {"en": "What’s your opinion on the trend of “lying flat” or “letting things go” that’s often seen on social media? Do you see it as a way of expressing shared feelings—or as a form of avoiding reality?", "zh": "社交媒体上鼓励“躺平”或“摆烂”的文化，你怎么看？它是共鸣还是逃避？"}]

topics.title: White Lies
topics.questions: [{"en": "In what kind of situations do you think telling a white lie is acceptable—or even necessary?", "zh": "在什么样的情境下，你认为说善意的谎言是可以接受甚至是必要的？"}, {"en": "Do you think white lies are truly harmless? What kind of long-term impact can they have on relationships?", "zh": "你觉得“善意的谎言”真的无害吗？它对关系的长期影响是什么？"}, {"en": "If you find out someone told you a white lie, are you more likely to understand their intention or try to get to the truth?", "zh": "如果你发现别人对你说了一个善意的谎言，你更倾向于理解对方，还是追问真相？"}, {"en": "Some people use the excuse of being \"kind\" to avoid honest conversations, often because they fear conflict or consequences. Do you think white lies sometimes become a way to avoid real communication? What's your take on that?", "zh": "一些人借“善意”为名回避直接表达，实际上是害怕冲突或承担后果。 善意的谎言会不会成为人们逃避真实沟通的借口？你怎么看？"}]

topics.title: Plans and Changes
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think is the purpose of making plans? In a world full of uncertainty, is it still worth spending time planning?", "zh": "你觉得计划的意义是什么？在一个充满不确定性的世界里，我们还需要花时间去计划吗？"}, {"en": "When your original plan gets disrupted by something unexpected, what’s your usual first reaction? Do you think it comes more from your personality or your past experiences?", "zh": "当原定计划被突发状况打乱时，你通常的第一反应是什么？你觉得这是性格使然，还是经验塑造的？"}, {"en": "When you plan things in great detail, unexpected changes often happen. How do you balance careful planning with being flexible?", "zh": "当你的计划变得非常精细的时候，会经常发生与预期不符的情况。你如何看待精细规划与灵活应变之间的平衡？"}, {"en": "Some people are good at improvising, while others need a plan to take action. Which type are you? And which do you think works better in today’s world?", "zh": "有些人擅长临时发挥，有些人依赖计划才能行动。你属于哪种？你认为哪种方式更适合现代生活？"}]

topics.title: Starting Something New
topics.questions: [{"en": "Before starting something new, do you usually focus more on being fully prepared, or do you prefer to \"learn as you go\"? Why?", "zh": "开始一件新事物之前，你通常会更关注准备是否充分，还是更倾向于“边做边学”？为什么？"}, {"en": "Have you ever put off starting something because you were afraid of failing? Looking back, how do you feel about that hesitation?", "zh": "你曾因为害怕失败而迟迟不敢开始某件事吗？事后你怎么看待当时的犹豫？"}, {"en": "How much do support from others and your environment influence your decision to start something new? Do you think independence or support from others is more important?", "zh": "身边的支持和环境在你决定开始某件新事时起到了什么作用？你认为独立和他人支持哪个更重要？"}, {"en": "When you start something new and it doesn’t go as planned, do you tend to keep going, make adjustments, or give up? What’s your opinion on “quitting while you’re ahead”?", "zh": "当你开始一件新事物但效果不如预期时，你是倾向于坚持、调整，还是放弃？你怎么看待“知难而退”？"}]

topics.title: Setbacks
topics.questions: [{"en": "What’s the biggest setback you’ve ever experienced? How did you handle it at the time? Looking back now, what do you think you’ve learned from it? How have you changed because of it?", "zh": "你经历过的最大的挫折是什么？当时你是怎么面对这种挫折的？现在回头看这段经历，你觉得有哪些收获？自己发生了哪些改变？"}, {"en": "After facing setbacks, some people choose to talk to friends or family, while others prefer to deal with it on their own. Which way do you usually go with, and why?", "zh": "挫折之后，有的人选择向亲友倾诉，有的人选择独自消化。你倾向于哪种方式？为什么？"}, {"en": "When facing the same kind of hardship, some people bounce back quickly, while others really struggle. What do you think makes the difference? Is it personality, environment, or life experience?", "zh": "面对同样的打击，有些人能够迅速调整并重拾信心，有些人却会一蹶不振。你认为关键在于什么？是性格、环境，还是成长经历？"}, {"en": "Some people say that resilience is more important than intelligence. Do you agree with that? In your opinion, how can we stay positive when dealing with setbacks?", "zh": "有人说“抗挫折能力”比“聪明才智”更重要。你是否赞同这种观点？你认为怎么才能积极的面对挫折？"}]

topics.title: Satisfaction
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think \"satisfaction\" comes more from real achievements or from an inner mindset? In your personal experience, have there been moments when you felt this way?", "zh": "你觉得“满足感”更多来源于现实的成就，还是一种内在的心态？在你个人经历中，有没有这种感受的时刻？"}, {"en": "Why do people sometimes feel unsatisfied even when they have a lot? What do you think is the root of this mindset?", "zh": "为什么有时候人们即使已经拥有很多，仍然会觉得不满足？你认为这种心理的根源是什么？"}, {"en": "In your daily life, do you consciously try to \"create satisfaction\"? For example, have you ever tried keeping track of little things to be grateful for or deliberately delaying gratification?", "zh": "在日常生活中，你是否有意识地去“创造满足感”？比如记录值得感恩的小事、刻意延迟满足等方式，你是否尝试过？"}, {"en": "Do you think there is a contradiction between \"satisfaction\" and \"ambition\"? Can a person be content while also striving to become a better version of themselves?", "zh": "你认为“满足感”和“进取心”之间是否存在矛盾？一个人可以一边知足常乐，一边又不断追求更好的自己吗？"}]

topics.title: Making Use of Fragmented Time
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think small chunks of time, or “fragmented time,” can really be used efficiently? What kind of tasks do you think are best suited for these short periods?", "zh": "你觉得“碎片化时间”能被真正高效利用吗？哪些类型的任务最适合在零碎时间中完成？"}, {"en": "Have you ever tried to plan your fragmented time on purpose—like the 10 minutes after you wake up or the 5 minutes while waiting for a bus? How did you plan it, and did it work well?", "zh": "你有没有尝试过刻意规划碎片时间，比如早上起床后的10分钟或等车的5分钟？你是怎么规划的？效果如何？"}, {"en": "Some people think fragmented time should be used to relax, not to be productive. What’s your take on this? Which approach do you prefer?", "zh": "有人认为碎片时间应该用来“休息”，而不是“充实自己”，你怎么看？你更倾向于哪种方式？"}, {"en": "During fragmented time, there are “seemingly useless” things like daydreaming, taking a walk, or chatting with a friend. Do you think these things also have value? Should we encourage this kind of “non-productive” use of time too?", "zh": "零碎时间中“看似无用”的小事，比如发呆、散步、和朋友闲聊，它们是否也有价值？这种“非功利性使用”是否也值得被鼓励？"}]

topics.title: Generation Gap in Communication
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever felt a clear “generation gap” when talking to older or younger people? How did you deal with or ease that gap at the time?", "zh": "你在与长辈或晚辈交流时，有没有经历过明显的“代沟”？当时是如何应对或缓解这种隔阂的？"}, {"en": "Do you think the generation gap mainly comes from differences in the times we grew up in, or is it more about different ways of communicating and expressing ideas? Why?", "zh": "你认为“代沟”更多源自于时代背景的不同，还是沟通方式和表达习惯的差异？为什么？"}, {"en": "Have you ever tried to actively bridge the generation gap in your family, at work, or with friends? How did it go? What challenges did you face during the process?", "zh": "在家庭、职场或朋友之间，你有没有尝试过主动跨越“代沟”？效果如何？过程中遇到过哪些挑战？"}, {"en": "When you realize the other person doesn’t understand your point of view, are you more likely to stick to your opinion or choose to compromise? Which approach do you think helps improve understanding between generations?", "zh": "当你意识到对方无法理解你的观念时，你更倾向于坚持表达，还是选择妥协？你觉得哪种方式更容易促进代际理解？"}]

topics.title: Personal Image on Social Media
topics.titleZh: 社交媒体中的个人形象
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever posted something on social media that was a bit “beautified”? How do you tell if someone’s post is genuine or if they’re just trying to create a certain image? Does that affect how you feel about them or your relationship with them?", "zh": "你是否曾在社交媒体上发布过“美化”的内容？你如何判断别人发布的内容是真诚的，还是刻意营造的人设？这对你与他们的关系或印象有影响吗？"}, {"en": "When you see other people’s glamorous lives online, do you ever feel anxious or start doubting yourself? How do you usually deal with those emotions?", "zh": "当你在社交平台上看到别人光鲜亮丽的生活时，是否会产生焦虑或自我怀疑？你通常如何调节这种情绪？"}, {"en": "Some people say, “A like doesn’t mean they care, and a comment doesn’t mean they really know you.” What’s your take on these “surface-level” interactions on social media?", "zh": "有人说“点赞不等于关心，评论不等于了解”，你怎么看待社交媒体中人际关系的“浅层互动”？"}, {"en": "Do you think it’s possible to “be yourself” and “please your audience” at the same time on social media? If not, which one would you choose?", "zh": "你认为“做自己”和“迎合受众”在社交平台上是否可以兼容？如果不能，你会更倾向于哪一种？"}]

topics.title: Mental Exhaustion
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think is the root cause of mental exhaustion? Is it overthinking, emotional drain, or setting overly high expectations for yourself?", "zh": "你认为内耗的本质是什么？是源于过度思考、情绪消耗，还是对自我的过高要求？"}, {"en": "Some people tend to ruminate on past mistakes or regrets. Do you think this is a form of mental exhaustion? How can we find a balance between self-reflection and self-blame?", "zh": "有些人容易反复思考过去的失误或遗憾，你觉得这是内耗的一种表现吗？如何平衡反思与自责？"}, {"en": "What kind of mindset or habits can help reduce mental exhaustion? Have you tried any methods to adjust your mental state?", "zh": "你觉得什么样的思维方式或习惯可以有效减少内耗？你有尝试过哪些方法来调整自己的心理状态？"}, {"en": "Is mental exhaustion always a bad thing? Do you think self-reflection, when done right, can turn it into a source of personal growth?", "zh": "内耗是否完全是负面的？是否有可能通过适当的自我反思，让内耗变成促进成长的动力？"}]

topics.title: How to Get Along with Stubborn People
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever felt powerless or frustrated when dealing with a stubborn person? What makes communication difficult in these situations? Do you think their stubbornness comes mainly from their personality, experiences, or environmental influences?", "zh": "在与固执的人相处时，你是否曾感到无力或沮丧？是什么让你觉得沟通变得困难？你认为他们的固执主要源自性格、经验，还是环境影响？"}, {"en": "When facing a stubborn person, do you tend to stick to your opinion or choose to compromise? In what situations do you think it's important to stand your ground, and when is it better to step back?", "zh": "面对固执的人时，你倾向于坚持自己的观点，还是选择妥协？你认为在什么情况下应该坚持，什么情况下应该退让？"}, {"en": "Sometimes, stubbornness comes from a fear of the unknown or an excessive need to protect one’s own stance. How do you think patience and empathy can help them become more open to different viewpoints?", "zh": "有些固执可能是源于对未知的恐惧或对自己立场的过度保护。你认为如何用耐心和共情来帮助他们更开放地接受不同意见？"}, {"en": "When you realize you're being stubborn about something, how do you adjust your mindset? Do you think stubbornness can sometimes be a strength in certain situations?", "zh": "当你发现自己在某些事情上也变得固执时，你是如何调整自己的？你是否认为固执在某些情况下也可以是一种优点？"}]

topics.title: Apology
topics.questions: [{"en": "What elements do you think a sincere apology should contain? Is it to express regret, admit a mistake, or offer a remedy? In what situations might an apology seem perfunctory or ineffective?", "zh": "你认为一个真诚的道歉应该包含哪些要素？是表达后悔、承认错误，还是提出补救措施？哪些情况下，道歉可能显得敷衍或无效？"}, {"en": "Some people find it hard to apologize, whether it's due to pride, fear of looking weak, or believing an apology isn’t necessary. How do you think these mental barriers can be overcome? Do you think apologizing makes a person lose dignity?", "zh": "有些人很难开口道歉，可能是因为自尊心、害怕显得软弱，或者认为道歉没必要。你觉得这些心理障碍如何克服？道歉是否会降低一个人的尊严？"}, {"en": "Are there situations where apologizing is unnecessary or even harmful? For example, do you think some apologies might make a person seem overly submissive or encourage the other person to take their forgiveness for granted?", "zh": "在什么情况下，你认为道歉是不必要的，甚至可能是有害的？比如，是否有些道歉会让自己显得卑微，或让对方觉得自己理所当然？"}, {"en": "Besides simply saying \"I'm sorry,\" what are some other ways to show sincere remorse? Could actions, time, or other efforts to mend the relationship be more effective? Have you ever used or experienced an alternative way of apologizing?", "zh": "除了口头道歉，哪些方式可以更有效地表达歉意？是通过行动、时间来证明，还是以其他方式修复关系？你有过类似的经验吗？"}]

topics.title: Procrastination
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think is the root cause of procrastination? Is it a lack of self-discipline, fear of failure, or simply not feeling motivated enough? What usually causes you to procrastinate?", "zh": "你认为拖延的本质是什么？是缺乏自律、害怕失败，还是对任务没有足够的动力？你自己的拖延习惯通常是因为什么原因产生的？"}, {"en": "Procrastination often gives temporary relief but later leads to stress and anxiety. Why do we still choose to procrastinate even when we know it will have negative consequences? How does this psychological mechanism work?", "zh": "拖延往往让人短暂感到放松，但之后又会带来压力和焦虑。为什么明知后果不佳，我们仍然会选择拖延？这种心理机制是如何运作的？"}, {"en": "In your experience, what methods have been most effective in overcoming procrastination? Is it making a plan, setting rewards, or changing your environment? Have you tried any strategies that didn’t work well for you?", "zh": "在你的经验中，哪些方法对克服拖延最有效？是制定计划、设定奖励，还是改变环境？有没有一些方法你尝试过但效果不佳？"}, {"en": "Some people believe that a little procrastination can boost creativity and even help people perform better under pressure. Do you agree? Can procrastination ever have a positive effect in certain situations?", "zh": "有人认为适度的拖延可以促进创造力，甚至让人在压力下表现更好。你认同这种说法吗？拖延是否可能在某些情况下带来积极的作用？"}]

topics.title: How to Deal with Feeling Misunderstood
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever tried your best to express your thoughts or feelings, only to be misunderstood? How did you handle that situation?", "zh": "你是否曾有过努力表达自己的想法或感受，却仍然被误解的经历？当时你是如何处理这种情况的？"}, {"en": "When facing misunderstandings from family, friends, or colleagues, do you think it's more important to stay true to yourself or to adapt to their perspective? Why?", "zh": "在面对家人、朋友或同事的不理解时，你认为坚持自我更重要，还是尝试迎合对方的观点更合适？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think misunderstandings happen more because of communication issues or because of differences in values and life experiences? Is there a way to minimize the frustration caused by these differences?", "zh": "你认为不被理解更多是沟通方式的问题，还是人与人之间价值观、经历的差异导致的？有没有办法减少这种差异带来的困扰？"}, {"en": "When you feel misunderstood or unrecognized, how do you stay emotionally balanced and keep it from affecting your confidence and judgment?", "zh": "当你觉得自己被误解或不被认同时，如何在情绪上保持平衡，而不让这种感觉影响你的自信和判断？"}]

topics.title: Dependence on Electronic Devices
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever tried going without electronic devices for an extended period? How did it feel—relaxing, anxious, or just uncomfortable?", "zh": "你有没有尝试过长时间不使用电子设备？在这个过程中，你最强烈的感受是什么？是放松，焦虑，还是某种不适？"}, {"en": "Technology has made life more convenient, but it has also changed how we socialize, access information, and entertain ourselves. Do you think these changes are mostly positive or negative? Are there any aspects you’d like to adjust?", "zh": "电子设备带来了便利，也改变了我们的生活习惯，比如社交方式、信息获取方式和娱乐方式。你觉得这种改变是好是坏？有哪些方面是你希望调整的？"}, {"en": "Some people believe that over-reliance on electronic devices weakens real human connections, leading to less face-to-face interaction and shorter attention spans. Do you agree? Have you ever noticed this happening in your daily life?", "zh": "有人认为，过度依赖电子设备会削弱人与人之间的真实连接，比如面对面交流的减少、专注力的下降等。你是否认同？你在日常生活中有没有遇到类似的情况？"}, {"en": "While electronic devices make information more accessible, they also contribute to information overload. How do you manage your information intake and avoid being overwhelmed by fragmented content?", "zh": "电子设备让信息获取更加便捷，但也带来了信息过载的问题。你如何管理自己的信息输入，避免被碎片化信息淹没？"}]

topics.title: High-Quality Rest
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think rest simply means not working or studying, or should it involve something more intentional? In your opinion, what truly counts as high-quality rest?", "zh": "你认为“休息”只是单纯的不工作、不学习，还是应该有更积极的方式？在你看来，什么才是真正的高质量休息？"}, {"en": "Many people still feel exhausted even after taking time to rest—like spending the whole weekend lying around but not actually feeling refreshed. Why do you think this happens? How can we improve the way we rest?", "zh": "现代社会中，很多人即使在休息时仍然感到疲惫，例如周末“躺了一天”却依然没有恢复精力。你觉得是什么导致了这种现象？如何改善？"}, {"en": "In today’s fast-paced world, even when people have time to rest, they often feel anxious, worrying about wasting time or falling behind others. Where do you think this mindset comes from? How can we adjust our thinking to truly relax?", "zh": "在快节奏的现代社会，很多人即使有时间休息，也会感到焦虑，担心自己“浪费时间”或“落后于他人”。你觉得这种心理来自哪里？该如何调整？"}, {"en": "Have you ever intentionally planned high-quality rest for yourself, like setting a no-phone rule or taking regular trips? Did it work? Do you think rest should be carefully planned, or is it better to just go with the flow?", "zh": "你是否曾经刻意为自己安排高质量的休息，比如设定“无手机时间”或“定期旅行”？这种方法是否有效？你认为休息是否需要刻意规划？"}]

topics.title: Decision-Making Struggles
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your daily life, what kind of decisions do you find the hardest to make? For example, choosing what to eat, shopping, or making career choices. What do you think is the main reason behind this difficulty?", "zh": "在日常生活中，你在做哪些类型的决定时最容易陷入选择困难？比如点餐、购物、职业选择等。你觉得造成这种困扰的主要原因是什么？"}, {"en": "Some people believe that the more choices you have, the less happy you feel because you might worry about making the wrong decision. Do you agree with this idea? Have you ever struggled to make a decision because you were afraid of choosing the wrong option? Some people try to reduce decision-making stress by limiting their choices, like wearing the same style of clothes every day or always ordering the same dish at a restaurant. Do you think having fewer choices brings more freedom or limits the variety of life? Why?", "zh": "有人认为选择越多，幸福感越低，因为人们会担心“选错”。你同意这种观点吗？你是否曾因为害怕做错选择而迟迟无法下决定？有人通过“减少选择”来缓解选择困难，比如固定穿同样风格的衣服、在特定餐厅固定点同样的菜等。你认为减少选择会带来更多的自由，还是限制了生活的多样性？为什么？"}, {"en": "When faced with multiple options, do you usually rely more on logical analysis (such as comparing prices, features, or pros and cons) or on your intuition and feelings? Which approach do you think helps you make better and more satisfying decisions?", "zh": "当你面对多个选项时，你通常会更依赖理性分析（如比较价格、功能等），还是更依赖直觉和感觉？你觉得哪种方式更有助于做出满意的决定？"}, {"en": "After making a decision, if the result doesn’t turn out as expected, do you often feel regret or blame yourself for making the wrong choice? How do you usually adjust your mindset to reduce anxiety about the outcome of your decision?", "zh": "当你做出一个决定后，如果结果不如预期，你会产生“选择悔恨”吗？你通常是如何调整自己的心态以减少对选择结果的焦虑？"}]

topics.title: Spending Habits
topics.questions: [{"en": "How did your spending habits develop? Were they influenced by your family, social trends, or your personal values? When making purchasing decisions, do you tend to be more rational or emotional?", "zh": "你的消费习惯是如何形成的？是受家庭影响、社会潮流，还是自己的价值观？在消费决策上，你更倾向于理性消费还是情绪消费？"}, {"en": "What do you think about the temporary satisfaction that comes from shopping? Do you see impulse buying as a natural part of human nature or as something shaped by modern consumer culture?", "zh": "你如何看待“买买买”带来的短暂满足感？你觉得这种消费冲动是人性的一部分，还是现代商业环境塑造的结果？"}, {"en": "When you shop, do you prioritize brand and social recognition, or do you focus more on practicality and value for money? Have your preferences changed over time as you’ve gained more life experience?", "zh": "在消费时，你更注重商品的品牌和社会认同感，还是更关注实用性和性价比？这种倾向是否随着年龄或经历发生过变化？"}, {"en": "With consumerism on the rise, do you think minimalism or material enjoyment is a better lifestyle choice for modern society? Which one would you personally choose, and why?", "zh": "随着消费主义的盛行，你认为“极简主义”和“物质享乐”哪种生活方式更适合现代社会？你会选择哪一种，为什么？"}]

topics.title: Failure
topics.questions: [{"en": "What is the most memorable failure you have experienced? How did it impact your growth and perspective? How do you define failure—is it simply not achieving your expected goal, or does real failure mean not learning anything from the experience?", "zh": "你经历过最让你印象深刻的一次失败是什么？这次失败对你的成长和认知产生了怎样的影响？你认为失败的定义是什么？是没有达到预期目标，还是指从失败中没有学到任何东西？"}, {"en": "Some people believe that \"failure is the mother of success,\" while others fear failure so much that they hesitate to take risks. How do you think we can find true value in failure instead of letting it become a mental burden?", "zh": "有些人认为“失败是成功之母”，但也有人因为害怕失败而止步不前。你认为如何在失败中找到真正的价值，而不是让失败成为心理负担？"}, {"en": "Do you see failure as a reflection of personal ability, or do you think it’s more about circumstances and luck? In what situations do you attribute failure to yourself, and when do you see it as the result of external factors?", "zh": "你认为失败是个人能力的体现，还是环境和运气的结果？在什么情况下，你会把失败归因于自己，什么时候又会归因于外部因素？"}, {"en": "Society often highlights success stories while avoiding discussions about failure. How do you think we can change our perspective on failure so that it becomes a healthier part of personal growth? Does failure affect your confidence? How do you maintain a positive self-image after failure instead of falling into self-doubt?", "zh": "社会往往更强调成功故事，而对失败讳莫如深。你认为我们应该如何改变对失败的看法，使其成为更健康的成长经历？失败是否会影响你的自信心？你如何在失败后保持积极的自我认同，而不是陷入自我怀疑？"}]

topics.title: How to Deal with Being Compared to Others
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever been compared to others while growing up? How did this experience affect your confidence and sense of self-identity?", "zh": "你是否曾在成长过程中被拿来与他人比较？这种经历对你的自信心和自我认同产生了什么影响？"}, {"en": "Do you think social competition inevitably leads to comparisons between people? In such an environment, how can we adjust our mindset? When family, friends, or colleagues unintentionally compare you to others, how do you respond? Do you feel the need to prove yourself to them, or do you think focusing on your own growth is more important?", "zh": "你认为社会竞争是否不可避免地会带来人与人之间的比较？面对这种环境，我们应该如何调整自己的心态？当亲友或同事无意间对你进行比较时，你会如何回应？你觉得有必要向他们证明自己，还是专注于自己的成长更重要？"}, {"en": "When being compared to others, how do you distinguish between “positive motivation” and “negative pressure”? How can comparisons be turned into a driving force for growth rather than a source of anxiety?", "zh": "当你被拿来与他人比较时，你是如何区分“积极的激励”与“消极的压力”的？怎样才能让比较成为促进成长的动力，而不是焦虑的来源？"}, {"en": "In the age of social media, people are constantly exposed to others' “highlight moments,” which can trigger comparison. How can we maintain inner balance in such an environment?", "zh": "在社交媒体盛行的时代，人们更容易看到别人的“高光时刻”，从而产生比较心理。你认为如何才能在这样的环境下保持内心的平衡？"}]

topics.title: Romantic Relationships
topics.questions: [{"en": "What key skills are essential for maintaining a healthy relationship? What are the most common reasons relationships face problems? Do you think happiness in a relationship comes more from personality compatibility or from sharing similar values and lifestyles?", "zh": "经营一段恋爱需要哪些核心能力？哪些因素最容易导致感情出现问题？你认为恋爱的幸福感更多来自于两个人的性格契合，还是相似的价值观和生活方式？"}, {"en": "How can you balance being in a relationship with personal growth? Does being in a relationship limit personal development, or can it provide support and motivation? In today’s world, where individuality and independence are highly valued, how can couples maintain personal space while keeping their relationship strong?", "zh": "恋爱关系和个人成长之间如何保持平衡？恋爱是否会限制一个人的发展，还是能够提供支持和动力？现代社会强调个体自由和独立，如何在恋爱关系中保持个人空间的同时，维护亲密关系？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the essence of marriage? Is it a continuation of love, a commitment to responsibility, or simply part of social structure? How is marriage different from dating?", "zh": "你认为婚姻的本质是什么？是爱情的延续、责任的承担，还是社会结构的一部分？婚姻与恋爱有哪些不同之处？"}, {"en": "In modern society, more and more people are choosing to marry later or not at all. What’s your view on this trend? Do you think marriage is still an essential part of life?", "zh": "在现代社会，越来越多的人选择不婚或晚婚，你怎么看待这种现象？婚姻是否仍然是人生的必需品？"}]

topics.title: Side Hustles(副业)
topics.questions: [{"en": "Is there a side hustle you’ve thought about trying or are already doing? In your opinion, what fields or jobs are best suited for a side hustle? What skills are needed for those roles?", "zh": "你有想尝试，或者已经在做的做副业的方向吗？在你看来，哪些领域或岗位比较适合做副业？这些岗位需要具备什么能力？"}, {"en": "Do you think a side hustle should be related to your main job or completely different? Which approach is better for personal growth? When choosing a side hustle, should you prioritize your interests or market demand? If the two conflict, how would you decide?", "zh": "你认为副业应该与主业相关，还是应该完全不同？哪种方式更有利于个人发展？在选择副业时，应该优先考虑个人兴趣，还是市场需求？如果两者冲突，你会如何抉择？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the main motivation for having a side hustle? Is it about making extra money, pursuing a passion, or improving career prospects? Some people believe a side hustle brings more freedom and security, while others think it adds stress. What’s your take?", "zh": "你认为选择副业的主要动机是什么？是为了经济收入、兴趣发展，还是为了提升职业竞争力？有些人认为副业可以带来更多的自由和安全感，但也有人觉得它会增加压力，你怎么看？"}, {"en": "A side hustle requires time and effort—how can you make sure it doesn’t affect your main job? Are there any ways to boost efficiency?", "zh": "副业需要投入时间和精力，如何避免它影响主业的表现？有没有什么方法可以提高效率？"}]

topics.title: How to Maintain a Good State
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think defines a “good state”? Is it mainly about physical health, a positive mindset, or maintaining an efficient work-life balance?", "zh": "你认为“好的状态”主要体现在哪些方面？是身体健康、精神愉悦，还是高效的工作和生活节奏？"}, {"en": "When you’re feeling low, what do you usually do to adjust and recover? Do these methods always work for you?", "zh": "当你发现自己状态低迷时，你通常会采取哪些方法来调整和恢复？这些方法对你来说是否总是有效？"}, {"en": "How do goal setting and life planning help in maintaining a good state? How can you find balance in a busy life and avoid burning out?", "zh": "你认为目标管理和生活规划在保持好状态方面起到怎样的作用？如何在忙碌的生活中找到平衡，避免过度消耗？"}, {"en": "How do external factors and relationships affect your state? How do you stay calm and positive while dealing with external challenges?", "zh": "外部环境和人际关系对你的状态有何影响？你如何在面对外部挑战的同时，保持内心的平静和正能量？"}]

topics.title: Personal Boundaries
topics.questions: [{"en": "When do you feel your boundaries are crossed? What specific actions by others make you uncomfortable? For example, friends or family interfering too much in your life, giving unsolicited advice—how did you handle it?", "zh": "你在什么情况下会觉得自己的边界被侵犯？当别人做了什么事情时，你会感到不舒服？比如朋友或家人过度干涉你的生活、给你不需要的建议等，当时你是怎么处理的？"}, {"en": "How do you balance personal boundaries in relationships? If boundaries are too strict, people might see you as cold; if too loose, you might feel uneasy. What do you think is the “right” balance? Should boundaries be adjusted in different situations, like work, family, or friendships?", "zh": "你觉得人与人之间的边界感应该如何把握？太强会显得冷漠，太弱又可能让自己感到不舒服，你认为怎样才算合适？在工作、亲情、友情等不同的场合，是否需要把握不同尺度的边界感？"}, {"en": "In cross-cultural interactions (like work or study abroad), have you experienced misunderstandings due to different boundary norms? For instance, Western cultures often value personal space more, while East Asian cultures focus on group harmony. Even within China, northern and southern regions have differences. How can we bridge these gaps?", "zh": "在不同文化交际中（如职场或留学），你经历过因边界感差异引发的误解吗？例如，西方人可能更注重个人空间，而东亚文化更强调集体融入。在中国北方人和南方人的文化也有差异。这种差异如何调和？"}, {"en": "As life changes—like moving from school to work, or being single to married—do your expectations for boundaries shift? Why does this happen?", "zh": "随着人生阶段变化（比如从学生到职场人、单身到婚姻），你对人际边界的要求是否发生改变？这种变化的原因是什么？"}]

topics.title: Thoughts on the Chinese New Year Holiday
topics.questions: [{"en": "Did you make any specific plans for the holiday before it started (like spending time with family, traveling, or self-improvement)? How much did your actual activities differ from your plans? What does this gap reveal about your lifestyle or values?", "zh": "春节前你是否制定了明确的假期计划（如陪伴家人、旅行、学习充电）？实际执行与计划有多大差距？这种差距反映了你怎样的生活状态或价值观？"}, {"en": "During the holiday, did you feel any conflict between traditional customs (like paying New Year visits or family gatherings) and personal needs (like resting or having alone time)? How did you balance these two aspects? Did this balancing act make you rethink the meaning of traditional culture?", "zh": "在假期中，你是否感受到传统习俗（如拜年、聚餐）与个人需求（如休息、独处）之间的冲突？你是如何平衡这两者的？这种平衡是否让你反思传统文化的意义？"}, {"en": "During family gatherings, did you feel pressured by questions from relatives about your job, relationship status, or income? Did you choose to answer honestly or use some “social tactics” to dodge these questions? What kind of generational gap does this communication style reflect?", "zh": "春节聚会中，家人或亲戚的提问（如工作、婚姻、收入）是否让你感到压力？你是选择坦诚回应，还是用“社交话术”应对？这种沟通方式反映了怎样的代际差异？"}, {"en": "After the holiday, do you feel tired from “post-holiday syndrome,” or are you full of energy for the new phase? Do you think the effect of holidays on personal well-being is overrated?", "zh": "春节结束后，你是感到“假期综合征”的疲惫，还是对新阶段充满动力？你认为假期对个人状态的调整作用是否被高估了？"}]

topics.title: The Impact of AI on Life and Work
topics.titleZh: AI对生活和工作产生的影响
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever used AI technology in your daily life or work? In what ways has it improved your efficiency or brought you new experiences? What tasks would you like AI to help you with?", "zh": "你是否在日常生活或工作中使用过AI技术？它在哪些方面提升了你的效率，或者给你带来了新的体验？你希望AI能够帮你做哪些事情？"}, {"en": "How do you think AI specifically impacts your profession? Does it enhance efficiency, or does it introduce new competition? If part of your job were replaced by AI, how would you choose to respond?", "zh": "你认为AI对你的职业领域有什么具体的影响？是增加了效率，还是带来了新的竞争？如果你的工作中有一部分任务被AI取代，你会选择如何应对？"}, {"en": "Beyond your own work, how do you think the widespread adoption of AI will affect the job market? Which professions might face challenges, and which ones might benefit from AI-driven growth?", "zh": "除了你本身的工作之外，你认为AI的普及会对就业市场产生怎样的影响？哪些职业可能会受到挑战，哪些职业可能会因此得到发展？"}, {"en": "Will AI impact human creativity and critical thinking? In your opinion, how can people maintain their core competitive advantage in the AI era?", "zh": "AI是否会影响人类的创造力和思考能力？你认为人类应该如何在AI时代保持自身的核心竞争力？"}]

topics.title: The summary of the past year
topics.questions: [{"en": "Looking back at the past year, what do you think was your biggest achievement? How did these achievements positively impact your life or work? Was there anything you regret? If you could choose again, how would you handle it?", "zh": "回顾过去一年，你觉得自己最大的收获是什么？这些收获对你的生活或工作产生了哪些积极的影响？有没有让你感到遗憾的事情？如果可以重新选择，你会如何应对？"}, {"en": "Did you accomplish the goals you set at the beginning of the year? If not, what do you think were the main reasons?", "zh": "你是否完成了年初设定的目标？如果没有完成，你觉得主要原因是什么？"}, {"en": "In what areas do you feel you’ve made noticeable progress or grown as a person? What actions or decisions led to this progress? Are there areas where you’d like to improve further?", "zh": "你觉得自己在哪些方面有了明显的进步或成长？这些进步源于哪些行动或决定？有哪些方面自己想做的更好？"}, {"en": "Regarding learning English, have you made any new achievements over the past year? Based on your experiences, what tips or lessons would you share with others?", "zh": "在学习英语方面，自己在过去一年是否有新的收获？在过去一年的经历中，有哪些学习的经验或建议可以分享？"}]

topics.title: Education
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think is the main purpose of education? Is it to gain knowledge, develop skills, or shape values and character? Why?", "zh": "你认为教育的主要目标是什么？是获取知识、培养技能，还是塑造价值观和人格？为什么？"}, {"en": "During your growth, has any teacher, elder, or subject had a significant impact on you? How did it help you grow?", "zh": "在你的成长经历中，是否有某位老师、长辈或者某一门课程对你产生了深远的影响？这对你的成长有什么帮助？"}, {"en": "Do you think the motivation to learn comes more from external pressure (like exams or competition) or internal interest? How do you think we can spark intrinsic motivation for learning?", "zh": "你认为学习的动力更多来源于外部压力（如考试、竞争）还是内部兴趣？你认为怎样可以激发内在学习动力？"}, {"en": "Based on your experiences and those of your family and friends, is there a strong connection between education and current work or life situations? How has education influenced future work and life? What type of education or content do you think would be most helpful for work and life in the future?", "zh": "根据你自己的经历，以及身边家人朋友的经历，受教育的经历和目前的工作生活状态是紧密相关的吗？教育对以后的工作生活产生了哪些影响？你觉得什么样的教育方式和教育内容，会对以后的工作生活有很大的帮助？"}]

topics.title: Dealing with Strangers
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you usually feel comfortable or nervous when talking to strangers? In situations where you need to start a conversation, how do you break the ice?", "zh": "你在与陌生人交流时通常会感到自在还是紧张？遇到需要主动开口的情况，你会如何破冰？"}, {"en": "What communication skills or attitudes do you think help make strangers feel comfortable and build trust?", "zh": "你认为在与陌生人打交道时，哪些沟通技巧或态度最能让对方感到舒服和信任？"}, {"en": "In unfamiliar environments, like during travel or business trips, how do you quickly adapt and interact with locals?", "zh": "在陌生的环境中，比如旅行或出差，你如何快速适应并与当地人打交道？"}, {"en": "Do you think the way people interact with strangers online has changed with the growth of the internet? Would you have deep conversations with strangers online?", "zh": "你认为随着互联网的发展，人们与陌生人在线上互动的方式是否发生了变化？你会与陌生人在网络上进行深入的交流吗？"}]

topics.title: Chinese New Year Customs
topics.questions: [{"en": "Where is your hometown? What unique ways, traditional activities, or special foods does your hometown have for celebrating Chinese New Year?", "zh": "你的家乡是哪里的？在你家乡，春节有哪些独特的庆祝方式、传统活动或者特色美食？"}, {"en": "What part of the Chinese New Year atmosphere do you look forward to the most? Is it family reunions, food, or traditional customs? Why? What are your plans for the holiday?", "zh": "你觉得目前春节的氛围最让你期待的是什么？是与家人团聚、美食，还是传统习俗？为什么？你计划在春节假期做哪些事情？"}, {"en": "How does the Chinese New Year atmosphere now compare to when you were a child? Do these changes make you happy, or do you miss the past? What do you think caused these changes?", "zh": "你小时候的春节和现在相比，氛围有没有什么不同？这些变化是让你感到开心还是怀念过去？你觉得是什么原因造成了这种变化？"}, {"en": "If you could experience the Chinese New Year in another place, where would you like to go? Which place’s celebrations do you think would leave a deep impression on you?", "zh": "如果有机会去其他地方感受春节氛围，你最想去哪里？你觉得哪里的春节庆祝活动会给你留下深刻印象？"}]

topics.title: Excessive care
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do your friends, family, or colleagues care too much about you? What is the specific performance? How does excessive caring affect you?", "zh": "你身边的朋友、家人或者同事，会对你有过度的关心吗？具体表现是怎样？过度的关心给你带来怎样的影响？"}, {"en": "If you feel overly concerned from others, how do you express your true feelings without hurting the other person's good intentions?", "zh": "如果你感受到来自他人的过度关心，你会如何表达自己的真实感受而不伤害对方的好意？"}, {"en": "Where do you think the line is between overbearing concern and appropriate care? How can you tell if you care more than the other person is willing to accept?", "zh": "你认为过度的关心和适度的关心之间的界限在哪里？如何判断自己的关心是否超过了对方的接受范围？"}, {"en": "What communication strategies do you think can make concern feel more natural and acceptable rather than overwhelming?", "zh": "你认为什么样的沟通方式可以让关心显得更自然且被对方接受，而不是显得过于强烈？"}]

topics.title: New Year Plans
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you usually make plans at the beginning of a new year? What plans have you made this year, and why are these goals important to you?", "zh": "在每年开始的时候，你会为新的一年做规划吗？今年你做了哪些规划？这些目标对你有什么重要意义？"}, {"en": "Once you have your plans, how do you make sure you achieve them? What methods do you use to stay motivated and focused?", "zh": "有了规划之后，你会通过什么方式让自己实现自己的规划？你通常会采取哪些方法来保持动力和专注？"}, {"en": "When creating your New Year plans, do you prefer detailed schedules or more flexible and adaptable approaches?", "zh": "在制定新年规划时，你会更倾向于详细的计划，还是更注重灵活性和适应性？"}, {"en": "Do you set easier goals or more challenging ones? If you can’t achieve your goals, do you tend to feel more anxious?", "zh": "当你做规划的时候，你更喜欢设立容易得目标，还是困难的目标？当自己的目标完不成的时候，是否会变得更加焦虑？"}]

topics.title: Make subtractions in work and life
topics.titleZh: 在工作和生活中做减法
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever tried decluttering your life? What made you decide to start?", "zh": "1.你是否尝试过在生活中进行断舍离？是什么原因促使你开始这项改变？"}, {"en": "Do you see decluttering as just getting rid of stuff, or is it more about a lifestyle and mindset change? Has it made any difference for you?", "zh": "2.你认为断舍离只是简单地丢弃物品，还是一种生活方式和思维方式的转变？这是否会让你的生活发生变化"}, {"en": "Letting Go of Unnecessary Activities:\n3. Are there social activities or habits that feel like a burden to you? How do you figure out what really matters?", "zh": "3.在生活中，是否有一些社交活动或习惯让你感到负担？你会如何筛选出对你真正重要的事情？"}, {"en": "What’s the hardest part of simplifying your life? How do you deal with the discomfort of letting go of certain habits or commitments?", "zh": "4.你觉得在做减法的过程中，最大的挑战是什么？如何克服放弃一些习惯或事务时的不安感？"}]

topics.title: Career options:
topics.questions: [{"en": "Which do you think is more important in choosing a career: personal interest or financial benefits? Has your opinion been influenced by your own experiences?", "zh": "你认为兴趣和经济收益哪个对职业选择更重要？你的看法是否受到自身经历的影响？"}, {"en": "If a career aligns perfectly with your interests but offers low financial benefits, would you stick with it? Why or why not?", "zh": "如果一个职业完全符合你的兴趣，但经济收益较低，你会选择坚持吗？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think it’s possible to find a balance between interest and financial benefits? What are some ways to achieve both?", "zh": "你认为兴趣和经济收益之间可以找到平衡点吗？有哪些方法可以实现两者兼顾？"}, {"en": "If you choose a career focused on financial benefits, how can you find a sense of achievement and enjoyment in your work?", "zh": "4.如果选择以经济收益为导向的职业，如何在工作中找到成就感和乐趣？"}]

topics.title: The importance of choice and effort
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think success comes more from hard work or making the right choices? Can you share any real-life examples to support your view?", "zh": "你认为成功更多来源于努力，还是做出正确的选择？有没有实际的例子支持你的观点？"}, {"en": "If you’ve put significant effort into the wrong path, would you keep going or choose to start over? Why?", "zh": "如果你在一条错误的道路上投入了大量努力，你会坚持下去还是选择重新开始？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think the importance of effort and choices has changed in modern society? Why do you think these changes have occurred?", "zh": "你认为在现代社会中，努力和选择的重要性是否有变化？为什么会有这样的变化？"}, {"en": "Do you think differences in talent and resources affect the importance of choices and effort? How have these factors played a role in your life?", "zh": "你觉得天赋和资源的差异是否会影响选择和努力的重要性？这些因素在你生活中起了怎样的作用？"}]

topics.title: Misses and regrets in life
topics.questions: [{"en": "Have you ever missed an important opportunity because of a decision or hesitation? If you could go back, what would you do differently?", "zh": "1.你是否曾因为某个决定或犹豫不决而错过了重要的机会？如果可以重来，你会如何选择？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the best attitude toward missed opportunities and regrets? Should we accept reality or try to make up for them?", "zh": "2.你觉得面对错过和遗憾，最好的态度是什么？是接受现实，还是努力去弥补？"}, {"en": "Do you believe that missing out is an inevitable part of life? Has the experience of missing something helped you better understand your priorities?", "zh": "3.你是否认为错过也是一种人生的必然？错过的经历是否帮助你更清楚地认识自己的优先事项？"}, {"en": "What advice would you give to help others avoid regretting missed important things in the future?", "zh": "4.你会有什么建议来帮助以后减少错过重要事情的遗憾？"}]

topics.title: Low-key or High-key Behavior
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your daily life or work, do you prefer to keep a low profile or actively showcase yourself? What makes you choose this approach?", "zh": "12.15 主题：低调与高调"}, {"en": "Do you think low-key individuals are more likely to be overlooked or to earn trust? Why? In team collaboration, can being high-key and showcasing one’s abilities create pressure for others? How can people find a suitable way to present themselves?", "zh": "在生活或工作中，你更倾向于低调行事还是高调表现？是什么原因让你选择这样的方式？"}, {"en": "Have you ever faced misunderstandings or challenges because of being low-key or high-key in your approach? How did you deal with it?", "zh": "你认为低调的人更容易被忽视还是更容易赢得信任？为什么？在团队合作中，高调展示自己的能力是否会让人感到压力？你觉得应该如何找到合适的表现方式？"}, {"en": "Do you think there’s an ideal balance between being low-key and high-key in how people present and act? Under what circumstances would you change your usual approach?", "zh": "你是否经历过因为低调或高调而带来的误解或困扰？当时是如何处理的？"}, {"en": "Do you think there's an ideal balance between low-key and high-profile? Under what circumstances would you choose to change the way you behave?", "zh": "你认为低调和高调之间有没有一个理想的平衡点？在什么情况下，你会选择改变自己的表现方式？"}]

topics.title: Utilization of fragmented time
topics.questions: [{"en": "In daily life, do you think you are good at using fragmented time? Can you share some specific examples?", "zh": "1.在日常生活中，你觉得自己是否善于利用零碎时间？有哪些具体的例子？"}, {"en": "Do you usually use fragmented time to complete tasks, learn new skills, or relax? Why do you choose to do so?", "zh": "2.你通常会用零碎时间来完成任务、学习新技能，还是放松休息？为什么会选择这样做？"}, {"en": "If you want to use fragmented time more efficiently, what habits or skills do you think you need to develop?", "zh": "3.如果你想更高效地利用零碎时间，你觉得需要培养哪些习惯或技巧？"}, {"en": "Do you think using fragmented time can negatively affect your focus? How can this be avoided?", "zh": "4.你认为利用零碎时间是否会对自己的注意力产生负面影响？如何避免这种情况？"}]

topics.title: alone
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you enjoy spending time alone? What do you usually do when you're by yourself?", "zh": "你喜欢独处的时光吗？独处时你通常会做些什么？"}, {"en": "Do you find it easier to focus or achieve inner peace when you're alone? Why?", "zh": "在独处时，你是否更容易集中注意力或找到内心的平静？为什么？"}, {"en": "When you feel lonely, does being alone have a positive or negative effect on your emotions? How do you cope with it?", "zh": "当你感到孤独时，独处对你的情绪有正面还是负面的影响？你是如何调整的？"}, {"en": "In today’s fast-paced world, how do you think we can balance alone time and social interactions?", "zh": "在现代快节奏的生活中，你认为如何平衡独处和社交之间的关系？"}]

topics.title: Digital Wellness and Balance
topics.questions: [{"en": "How much time do you spend on electronic devices each day? Do you think this time has a positive or negative impact on your health and life?", "zh": "1.你每天花多少时间在电子设备上？你认为这些时间对你的健康和生活有积极还是消极的影响？"}, {"en": "Have you ever felt tired or stressed due to excessive use of electronic devices? How did you adjust at that time?", "zh": "2.你是否有过因为过度使用电子设备而感到疲惫或压力的经历？当时你是如何调整的？"}, {"en": "How do you think we can balance the use of electronic devices between work, study, and entertainment? Do you have any specific methods to share?", "zh": "3.你觉得如何在工作、学习和娱乐之间找到使用电子设备的平衡？有没有一些具体的方法可以分享？"}, {"en": "In today’s digital lifestyle, is it realistic to completely disconnect from electronic devices? If possible, how would you plan a period of \"digital detox\"?", "zh": "4.在如今数字化的生活中，完全离开电子设备是否现实？如果可能的话，你会如何安排一段“数字排毒”的时间？"}]

topics.title: Break out of your comfort zone
topics.questions: [{"en": "12.01 Topic: Stepping Out of Your Comfort Zone", "zh": "1.你是否曾经尝试过突破自己的舒适区？当时是因为什么原因决定这么做的？"}, {"en": "Have you ever tried stepping out of your comfort zone? What made you decide to do it at that time?", "zh": "2.在面对未知领域或挑战时，你最担心的是什么？你是如何克服这些担忧的？"}, {"en": "When facing an unfamiliar area or challenge, what worries you the most? How do you overcome these concerns?", "zh": "3.你认为突破舒适区需要更多的勇气还是计划性？在你看来，哪一个更重要？"}, {"en": "Do you think stepping out of your comfort zone requires more courage or careful planning? Which one do you think is more important?", "zh": "4.对于那些害怕改变的人，你会给他们什么建议来帮助他们迈出第一步？"}, {"en": "What advice would you give to someone who is afraid of change to help them take the first step?", "zh": "您会给那些害怕改变的人什么建议来帮助他们迈出第一步？"}]

topics.title: empathy
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think you are someone with empathy? In what situations do you find it particularly easy to understand other people's feelings?", "zh": "1.你认为自己是一个具有同理心的人吗？在什么样的情况下，你会感到特别容易理解别人的感受？"}, {"en": "When you disagree with someone, how do you use empathy to handle conflicts and differences?", "zh": "2.当你和他人意见不一致时，你会如何运用同理心来处理分歧和矛盾？"}, {"en": "Do you believe empathy is an innate talent, or can it be developed through learning and practice? Have you tried any methods to improve your empathy?", "zh": "3.你觉得培养同理心是一种天赋，还是可以通过后天学习和练习获得的？你是否尝试过某种方法来提高自己的同理心？"}, {"en": "Does empathy have limits? When empathy turns into \"over-empathizing,\" how do you balance your emotions and energy?", "zh": "4.同理心是否有界限？当同理心变成“过度共情”时，你会如何平衡自己的情绪和能量？"}]

topics.title: uncertainty
topics.questions: [{"en": "What are some uncertain factors in your life? For example, uncertainty in career development, daily life, or a specific situation. How do you approach uncertain situations when they arise?", "zh": "1.在你的生活中，有哪些不确定性的因素？比如职业发展的不确定性、生活的不确定性、或者某件事情的不确定性等等？当你遇到不确定的事情时，你会采取什么态度来面对？"}, {"en": "Do you think uncertainty brings you more stress or unlocks more potential? Why?", "zh": "2.你认为不确定性是给你打来了更多的压力，还是激发你更多的潜能？为什么？"}, {"en": "When faced with an uncontrollable uncertainty, how do you stay calm and keep moving forward?", "zh": "3.当面对一个无法控制的不确定因素时，你会如何让自己保持冷静并继续前进？"}, {"en": "Do you think accepting and adapting to uncertainty is a skill? How can it help with personal growth and development?", "zh": "4.你认为接受并适应不确定性是一种能力吗？这对个人成长和发展有什么帮助？"}]

topics.title: suggestion
topics.questions: [{"en": "In what situations do you usually offer advice to others? Are your suggestions more about solving problems or sharing your own experiences?", "zh": "1.你通常在什么情况下会主动给别人建议？这些建议更倾向于解决问题，还是分享你的经验？"}, {"en": "How do you feel when your advice is ignored or rejected? How do you adjust your mindset in such situations?", "zh": "2.当你的建议被别人忽视或拒绝时，你会有什么样的感受？你会如何调整自己的心态？"}, {"en": "When giving advice, do you think it’s more important to focus on how you say it or on the content itself? Why?", "zh": "3.你觉得给别人建议时，应该更注重表达的方式还是建议的内容本身？为什么？"}, {"en": "In your opinion, when is it not appropriate to give advice? Have you ever experienced a misunderstanding caused by offering advice?", "zh": "4.你认为在什么情况下不适合给别人建议？有没有出现过因为给建议而导致误会的经历？"}]

topics.title: consumption concept
topics.questions: [{"en": "When choosing a product to buy, do you value quality, price, or brand image more? Which factor do you think best reflects your consumption mindset?", "zh": "在选择购买商品时，你更看重产品的质量、价格，还是品牌形象？你认为哪一个因素最能反映你的消费观念？"}, {"en": "Have you ever regretted overconsumption? When faced with unnecessary spending temptations, how do you make rational decisions? What methods do you use to avoid impulse buying?", "zh": "你是否有过因过度消费而后悔的经历？在面对不必要的消费诱惑时，你是如何做出理性决策的？你有哪些方法避免冲动消费？"}, {"en": "How do you think we can strike a balance between being frugal and indulging in consumption? Do you tend to lean more towards frugality or a hedonistic consumption style?", "zh": "3.你认为“节俭”和“享乐消费”之间应该如何找到平衡？你自己是倾向于节俭还是享乐型消费？"}, {"en": "Do you support buying second-hand items? Do you think the concept of buying second-hand products will become more popular in society?", "zh": "4.你是否支持二手消费？你认为购买二手商品的观念是否会在社会中越来越普及？"}]

topics.title: talent
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think you have a special talent in any area? What is it, and how has this talent helped you?", "zh": "1.你觉得自己在某些方面有特别的天赋吗？是什么？这些天赋是如何帮助你的？"}, {"en": "Do you believe talent is something you’re born with, or can it be developed through effort? Why?", "zh": "2.你认为天赋是与生俱来的，还是可以通过后天的努力来弥补或培养的？为什么？"}, {"en": "If you don’t have a talent in a certain field but are passionate about it, would you still pursue growth in that area? Why?", "zh": "3.如果你在某个领域没有天赋，但对它充满热情，你会继续追求这个领域的发展吗？为什么？"}, {"en": "Which do you think is more important: talent or hard work? Do you have an example where hard work eventually surpassed talent?", "zh": "4.你觉得天赋和努力哪个更重要？有没有一个例子是努力最终超越了天赋的？"}]

topics.title: ideal self
topics.questions: [{"en": "What does your ideal self look like in your mind? In terms of career achievements, family relationships, personal interests, or other areas, what qualities or skills do you hope to have?", "zh": "1.你心目中理想的自己是什么样的？比如职业成就、家庭关系、个人兴趣，或者其他方面，有哪些特质或能力是你希望拥有的？"}, {"en": "What efforts are you currently making to become closer to your ideal self? Are there any areas you feel still need improvement?", "zh": "2.为了接近理想中的自己，你目前在做哪些努力？你觉得还有哪些方面需要改进？"}, {"en": "When facing challenges or setbacks, how would your ideal self respond? How do you try to incorporate this mindset into your own life?", "zh": "3.在面对挑战或挫折时，理想中的自己会如何应对？你是如何尝试将这种态度融入到自己的生活中的？"}, {"en": "At different stages in life, does your definition of your ideal self change? If so, what factors influence these changes?", "zh": "4。在不同的阶段，你对理想中的自己的定义会发生变化吗？如果会，这些变化受到什么因素的影响？"}]

topics.title: Chance
topics.questions: [{"en": "How do you determine if an opportunity is worth pursuing? What factors do you consider when making a choice?", "zh": "1.你如何判断一个机会是否值得去抓住？在面对选择时，你会考虑哪些因素？"}, {"en": "Have you ever missed an opportunity in life or work? Looking back, how do you feel about it, and what lessons have you learned?", "zh": "2.在生活或工作中，你有过错失机会的经历吗？回头看，你会有怎样的感受和反思？"}, {"en": "Do you think opportunities come more from luck or from effort? Why?", "zh": "3.你认为机会更多来自运气，还是努力创造的结果？为什么？"}, {"en": "How do you think one can develop the ability to seize opportunities while growing? What qualities or skills can help a person make the most of opportunities?", "zh": "4.你觉得在成长过程中，如何培养抓住机会的能力？有哪种特质或技能能帮助人更好地把握机会？"}]

topics.title: free
topics.questions: [{"en": "When choosing a lifestyle or career path, how important is freedom to you? Would you be willing to give up certain things for more freedom?", "zh": "1.在选择生活方式或职业道路时，自由对你的重要性有多大？你会为了更多的自由放弃一些其他的东西吗？"}, {"en": "Freedom often comes with a need for self-discipline. How do you think you can find a balance between freedom and self-management to support personal growth?", "zh": "2.自由有时伴随着自律的需求，你认为如何在自由和自我管理之间找到平衡，以达到有效的成长？"}, {"en": "In life, what do you think is the key to gaining freedom? Is it financial independence, control over your time, or something else?", "zh": "3.在生活中，你认为获取自由的关键是什么？它是财务的独立、时间的掌控，还是其他因素？"}, {"en": "Do you think your definition and need for “freedom” change as you grow? For example, has your idea of freedom evolved from your student years to your working years?", "zh": "4.你觉得随着成长，是否会对“自由”的定义和需求有所改变？比如从学生时代到工作阶段，你的自由观念有发生变化吗？"}]

topics.title: overthinking
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you consider yourself someone who tends to overthink? In what situations are you most likely to fall into this habit?", "zh": "1.你认为自己是一个容易过度思考的人吗？在什么样的情况下你会特别容易陷入这种状态？"}, {"en": "What do you think is the difference between overthinking and self-reflection? How can you find a balance between reflecting on your actions and getting stuck in overthinking?", "zh": "2.你觉得过度思考和自我反思之间的区别是什么？如何在反思自己的行为和陷入过度思考之间找到平衡？"}, {"en": "When making important decisions, do you often find yourself hesitating because of overthinking? How do you handle it in such situations?", "zh": "3.在做重要决定时，你会因为思虑过多而犹豫不决吗？这种情况下你会怎么应对？"}, {"en": "Do you think overthinking comes from a desire for perfection, or is it driven by a fear of failure? Why do you think this happens?", "zh": "4.你认为过度思考是因为追求完美，还是因为害怕失败？为什么会这样？"}]

topics.title: Learning motivation and interest
topics.questions: [{"en": "What factors do you think can spark your interest in a particular subject or skill? Can you share a learning experience that you found especially engaging?", "zh": "1.你觉得什么因素会激发你对某个科目或技能的学习兴趣？能分享一个让你特别感兴趣的学习经历吗？"}, {"en": "When you face difficulties or find the content boring during your studies, what do you do to stay motivated and keep learning?", "zh": "2.当你在学习过程中遇到困难或觉得内容枯燥时，你会怎么做来保持动力继续学习？"}, {"en": "Do you think motivation to learn comes more from internal interest or external pressure (like exams, work requirements, etc.)? Why?", "zh": "3.你认为学习的动力来自于内在的兴趣，还是外在的压力（比如考试、工作需要等）？为什么？"}, {"en": "In your opinion, is the process of learning something new more important, or is the result more important? Why?", "zh": "4.在你看来，学习新东西的过程更重要，还是结果更重要？为什么？"}]

topics.title: humor
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think a sense of humor is something people are born with, or can it be developed over time? Why?", "zh": "1.你觉得幽默感是与生俱来的吗，还是可以通过后天培养的？为什么？"}, {"en": "In your opinion, how important is a sense of humor in social interactions? Can you share a moment when humor helped you become closer to someone?", "zh": "2.在你看来，幽默感对人际交往有多重要？有没有一个幽默的时刻让你和他人关系变得更亲近？"}, {"en": "Do you think a funny joke needs a bit of cleverness and thought, or is it better when it's natural and spontaneous? Have you ever encountered a situation where someone tried to be humorous, but it didn’t turn out well?", "zh": "3.你觉得幽默的笑话需要一定的智慧和巧妙的构思吗，还是随性自然最好？你有没有遇到过试图用幽默表达自己，但效果却适得其反的情况？"}, {"en": "Do you think humor is appropriate in the workplace? In what situations can humor improve the work atmosphere, and when might it be inappropriate?", "zh": "4.你认为幽默可以用在职场中吗？在什么情况下幽默能提升工作氛围，什么情况下可能不合适？"}]

topics.title: happiness
topics.questions: [{"en": "What do you think happiness is? What things in your life make you truly happy and content?", "zh": "1.你认为什么是幸福？在你的生活中，有哪些事情能让你感到真正的幸福和满足？"}, {"en": "When you’re feeling down, what do you do to boost your sense of happiness? Do you have any tips or tricks to share?", "zh": "2.当你感到不快乐时，你会做些什么来提升自己的幸福感？有没有一些小技巧可以分享？"}, {"en": "How do you maintain a positive mindset and a sense of contentment when facing difficulties and setbacks?", "zh": "3.在面对困难和挫折的时候，你如何保持积极的心态和对生活的满足感？"}, {"en": "Have you ever felt envious of someone else’s life? Does this feeling affect your own happiness? How do you deal with it?", "zh": "4.你有没有羡慕过别人的生活？这种情绪会影响你的幸福感吗？你是如何应对的？"}]

topics.title: involution
topics.questions: [{"en": "1. How do you think \"involution\" is defined? Have you ever encountered a similar situation in your work or study? What do you think is the main reason for it?", "zh": "1.你认为“内卷”是如何定义的？在你的工作或学习中，有没有遇到过类似的情况？你觉得它的主要原因是什么？"}, {"en": "2. Do you think \"involution\" only exists in the workplace, or does a similar phenomenon occur in other aspects of life? Such as family, education, etc.", "zh": "2.你觉得“内卷”是否只存在于职场，还是生活的其他方面也会有类似的现象？比如家庭、教育等。"}, {"en": "3. What role do you think social structures and institutions play in the emergence of the \"involution\" phenomenon? topics.questions: [{"en": "What is your favorite movie? What is it about? Which movies have influenced your thinking? How did they impact you?", "zh": "4.有的电影能够影响人们的思想观念。能够影响你的思想观念的电影有哪些？对你产生了哪些影响？"}]

topics.title: mood
topics.questions: [{"en": "What factors do you think affect your emotions? For example, the weather, your environment, or other aspects of work or life? How do you think stable emotions affect you?", "zh": "2.你觉得保持情绪稳定重要吗？你认为稳定的情绪会对你产生什么影响？"}, {"en": "Do you believe emotions can be completely controlled? Or do you think sometimes emotions are uncontrollable? How do you view the uncontrollability of emotions?", "zh": "3.你认为情绪是可以被完全控制的吗？或者说你觉得情绪有时候是无法控制的？你是如何看待情绪的不可控性？"}, {"en": "When you feel stressed or down, what do you do to make yourself feel better? For example, exercising, listening to music, or talking with friends?", "zh": "4.当你感到压力或情绪低落时，你会做些什么来让自己感觉好一点？比如运动、听音乐、和朋友聊天等等？"}]

topics.title: Tools to improve efficiency
topics.questions: [{"en": "Which tools do you think have the most significant impact on your daily life and work efficiency? Why?", "zh": "在工作、学习和生活中，你会使用哪些工具来提升你的效率和改善你的生活？比如笔记软件、学习工具、效率应用、搜集信息等等"}, {"en": "Are you willing to pay for these tools? In what situations do you think you would be willing to pay?", "zh": "你认为哪些工具对你的日常生活和工作效率提升最明显、影响最大？为什么？"}, {"en": "Do you think using tools to assist with work and study might reduce your ability to think independently and practice skills? How do you balance using tools to improve efficiency with maintaining your own independent thinking and hands-on practice?", "zh": "2.你愿意为这些工具付费吗？你觉得什么情况下你会付费？"}, {"en": "3. Do you think using tools to assist work and learning will reduce your thinking and practical abilities? How to balance the relationship between using tools to improve efficiency and independent thinking and personal practice?", "zh": "3.你认为使用工具辅助工作和学习会降低自己的思考能力和实践能力吗？怎么来平衡使用工具提升效率与自己独立思考、亲身实践之间的平衡关系？"}]

topics.title: innovation
topics.questions: [{"en": "In your work and life, when you start something new, do you follow existing experience or explore entirely new methods?", "zh": "1.在工作和生活中，当你做一件新的事情时，你会遵循已有的经验，还是会探索全新的方法？"}, {"en": "Are you someone with a desire to explore? When you have experience with something, do you still seek to explore other possibilities?", "zh": "2.你是一个有探索欲的人吗？当你对一件事情有了经验，你还会去想探索其他的可能性吗？"}, {"en": "Do you think advice from others is important? How do you balance your own experience, others' advice, and your own innovation?", "zh": "3。你觉得别人对你的建议是否重要？如何平衡好自己已有的经验、别人对你的建议以及自己的创新，这三者之间的关系？"}, {"en": "When faced with a problem that requires an innovative solution, how do you usually begin your thought process?", "zh": "4.当你面临一个需要创新解决的问题时，你通常会如何开始你的思考过程？"}]

topics.title: Habit
topics.questions: [{"en": "What are your habits? Can it be living habits, work habits or study habits, etc.? How did you develop these habits?", "zh": "你觉得这些习惯对你的生活或工作产生了哪些影响？你是如何养成这些习惯的？"}, {"en": "Have you ever tried to change a habit? What does this process look like? What was the result?", "zh": "你曾经尝试过改变某个习惯吗？这个过程是怎样的？结果如何？"}, {"en": "How much influence do you think your environment or people around you have on your habits? Can you give an example?", "zh": "你认为环境或周围的人对你的习惯有多大的影响？能举个例子说明吗？"}]

topics.title: entertainment in life
topics.questions: [{"en": "How do you think these habits or hobbies impact your life? What inspired you to try this new activity?", "zh": "2.你认为这些习惯或爱好，对你的生活产生了哪些影响？会减轻你的压力吗？"}, {"en": "How do you balance your time between work or study and leisure activities? How do you think this balance affects your efficiency and mood?", "zh": "3.有没有哪种娱乐活动是你最近才开始尝试的？是什么激发了你去尝试这种新的活动？"}, {"en": "4. What impact do you think this balance has on your productivity and mood?", "zh": "4.你怎样平衡工作或学习与休闲娱乐之间的时间？你觉得这种平衡对你的效率和心情有什么影响？"}]

topics.title: social skills
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you enjoy participating in group activities? Would you try to change it?", "zh": "2.你是否喜欢参加集体活动？参加集体活动或者和陌生人相处时你是否会有压力？"}, {"en": "3. Do you like to make more friends or get along with a fixed few friends? Do you keep in touch with your friends often and do things together?", "zh": "3.你喜欢结交更多的朋友，还是喜欢和固定的少数朋友相处？你会经常和朋友保持联系并共同做一些事情吗？"}, {"en": "3. What impact do you think your personality has on your life and work? Will you try to change?", "zh": "3.你觉得你的性格对你的生活和工作有怎样的影响？你会尝试去改变吗？"}]

topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you have a habit of reading? What book are you currently reading? topics.questions: [{"en": "Are you an optimistic person about work or life? topics.questions: [{"en": "To improve work or study efficiency, what tools do you use? topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you ever feel anxious due to dissatisfaction with your work or life? What are the reasons for this anxiety, and how does it manifest specifically?", "zh": "你是否会因为自己的工作、生活不满意会产生焦虑？产生焦虑的原因是什么？具体是怎么表现出来的"}, {"en": "When those around you or your colleagues make progress or experience change, and you find yourself not doing so, does this cause you to feel anxious? Does witnessing the success of others lead to feelings of anxiety or a lack of self-confidence?", "zh": "当你身边的人或同事取得进步或变化时，而你自己却没有，你会变得焦虑吗？当你看到别人的成功，是否会变得焦虑或者不自信？"}, {"en": "What effective methods do you have for alleviating anxiety? topics.title: travel
topics.questions: [{"en": "1.How was your holiday? Is there anything memorable or worth sharing? Are you satisfied with your holiday?", "zh": "1.你的假期过得怎么样？有哪些难忘或者值得分享的事情吗？是否对你的假期感到满意？"}, {"en": "2. Regarding travel, do you prefer a relaxed and free way of traveling, or do you prefer a way with a lot of itineraries? When traveling, do you prefer to travel with less money or spend money to enjoy a better experience?", "zh": "2.对于旅行，你喜欢轻松自由的旅行方式，还是喜欢行程安排非常多的方式？在旅行过程中，你更喜欢用更少的钱来旅行还是喜欢花钱来享受更好的体验？"}, {"en": "3. Do you make detailed plans before traveling? What experience can you share in making strategies? If you don't plan ahead, how do you usually start your trip?", "zh": "3.在旅行之前，你会做详细的计划吗？在做攻略方面你有哪些经验可以分享？如果不提前做计划的话，你一般会以什么方式开始自己的旅行？"}, {"en": "4. Who do you usually choose to travel with? If you have differences of opinion while traveling, how would you usually deal with it?", "zh": "4.你一般会选择和谁一起出去旅行？在旅行中你们如果产生观点分歧，一般会怎么处理？"}]

topics.title: self motivation
topics.questions: [{"en": "1: How do you motivate yourself in study or work? How do you keep yourself motivated and focused when you're slacking off?", "zh": "1：你如何激发自己在学习或工作中的动力？当你懈怠的时候，如何让自己保持动力与专注力？"}, {"en": "2: What strategies do you use to rekindle your passion and motivation when faced with failure or setbacks? In what ways do you keep yourself confident?", "zh": "2：面对失败或挫折时，你有哪些策略来重新点燃自己的激情和动力？你有哪些方式让自己保持自信？"}, {"en": "3: Do you have a specific ritual or habit that activates your “motivation mode”? Can you describe it in detail?", "zh": "3：你是否有特定的仪式或习惯来启动你的“激励模式”？能具体描述一下吗？"}, {"en": "4: How do you balance self-motivation with rest and relaxation to avoid overexertion?", "zh": "4：你如何平衡自我激励与休息放松，以避免过度劳累？"}]

topics.title: Online speaking practice
topics.questions: [{"en": "1. Do you have your own idol? It could be an actor, sports star, or other public figure. How did you like him? Why do you like him?", "zh": "1.你有自己的偶像吗？可以是演员、体育明星、或者其他的公众人物。你是通过什么方式喜欢他的？为什么喜欢他？"}, {"en": "2. What positive impact has your idol brought to your life? Do they inspire you to do something special?", "zh": "2. 你的偶像给你的生活带来了哪些积极的影响？他们是否激励你去做一些特别的事情？"}, {"en": "3. How do you think some people change their views on their idols because of their negative news or actions? Would you stop liking your idol because of something they did?", "zh": "3.你怎么看待一些人因为偶像的负面新闻或行为而改变对他们的看法？你会因为偶像的某些行为而停止喜欢他们吗？"}, {"en": "4. What do you think of the phenomenon of idol worship? Do you think worshiping idols can help you grow as a person, or can it have negative consequences?", "zh": "4.你如何看待偶像崇拜现象？你认为崇拜偶像是否有助于个人成长，还是可能带来一些负面影响？"}]

topics.title: Emotional intelligence (EQ) in the workplace
topics.questions: [{"en": "1. Talk about your understanding of \"emotional intelligence\". What do you think is high emotional intelligence?", "zh": "1.谈谈你对“情商”的理解，你认为什么样算是高情商？"}, {"en": "2. How can emotional intelligence be used to facilitate effective communication and conflict resolution in the workplace? When you have a disagreement with a colleague or leader, how can you use emotional intelligence to resolve the conflict?", "zh": "2.在职场中，如何运用情商来促进有效沟通和冲突解决？当你和同事或领导产生分歧时，如何运用情商来解决冲突？"}, {"en": "3. In the workplace, do you think it is important to maintain a good relationship with leaders and colleagues? How can you use emotional intelligence to improve your relationships with your leaders and colleagues?", "zh": "3.在职场中，你认为与领导、同事保持良好的关系重要吗？如何利用情商来改善你与领导、同事的关系？"}, {"en": "4. Do you feel there is a clear way to improve emotional intelligence? Share your experience and advice", "zh": "4.你觉得有明确的方法提升情商吗？分享你的经验和建议"}]

topics.title: Shopping
topics.questions: [{"en": "Question 1: Are you used to shopping offline or online? What do you think is the biggest difference between the two?", "zh": "问题1:你习惯线下购物还是网上购物？你觉得两者最大的区别是什么？"}, {"en": "Question 2: Will you shop through live broadcast? Which online shopping platforms do you usually use to buy things? Recommend a website you often shop at or a blogger you like", "zh": "问题2:你会通过直播购物吗？你一般习惯使用哪些线上购物平台买东西？推荐一下你经常购物的网站或者喜欢的博主"}, {"en": "Question 3: Compared to a few years ago, have your shopping habits changed? When shopping, do you value price, quality or other factors more?", "zh": "问题3:相比较几年之前，你的购物习惯有发生变化吗？购物时你更看重价格、品质还是其他因素？"}]

topics.title: Friend
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you think it's necessary for friends to keep in touch often? How do you think friendships should be maintained? Share your experience.", "zh": "你认为朋友之间需要经常保持联系吗？友谊需要通过什么形式来维持？说说你的经历 真正的友谊是否能够经受时间和距离的考验？如果你与一个老朋友重新取得联系，你会选择怎样的方式和话题来恢复友谊？ 您认为朋友之间应该如何处理分歧和冲突？请举例说明。你更倾向于直接面对分歧，还是选择避免冲突？为什么？"}, {"en": "Can true friendship really stand the test of time and distance? If you were to reconnect with an old friend, how would you go about it and what topics would you choose to revive the friendship?", "zh": "真正的友谊真的能经得起时间和距离的考验吗？如果你要和一位老朋友重新取得联系，你会如何处理？你会选择哪些话题来重温友谊？"}, {"en": "How do you think friends should handle disagreements and conflicts? Please give an example. Would you prefer to confront differences directly or avoid conflict? Why?", "zh": "你认为朋友之间应该如何处理分歧和冲突？请举个例子。您愿意直接面对分歧还是避免冲突？为什么？"}]

topics.title: efficiency
topics.questions:
[{"en": "1: In your work, life and study, what habits or routines have you found to be particularly helpful in improving your personal efficiency? How do you develop these habits?
2: What tools do you have to improve your efficiency?
3: How important do you think rest and relaxation are to maintain high efficiency in study and work? How do you schedule your breaks?
4: Have you ever been in a situation where multitasking has made you less productive? How do you identify and avoid this type of inefficient multitasking?", "zh": "1:在你的工作、生活和学习过程中，有哪些习惯或例行活动你认为对提高个人效率特别有帮助？你是如何养成这些习惯的？"}, {"en": "2: What tools do you have to improve your efficiency?", "zh": "2:你有哪些工具、可以提升自己办事的效率？"}, {"en": "3: How important do you think rest and relaxation are to maintaining high efficiency during study and work? How do you organize your downtime?", "zh": "3：你认为在学习和工作中，休息和放松对于保持高效率有多重要？你是如何安排休息时间的？"}, {"en": "4: Have you ever experienced a situation where handling multiple tasks at the same time actually reduces your efficiency? How do you identify and avoid this type of inefficient multitasking?", "zh": "4:你是否经历过同时处理多个任务反而降低了效率的情况？你是如何识别并避免这种效率低下的多任务处理的？"}]

topics.title: mood
topics.questions:
[{"en": "Question 1: How do you recognize and manage your emotions? Can you clearly feel your own emotional changes and handle your emotions in a timely manner?
Question 2: How do you handle emotionally charged situations and what strategies do you use to stay calm and empathetic?
Question 3: Do you have any activities or hobbies that relieve stress and emotional tension? Are they helpful to you? How do you find time to do these things?", "zh": "问题1:你如何认识和管理自己的情绪的？你能清晰感受自己的情绪变化并及时处理自己的情绪吗？
问题2:你如何处理情绪激动的情况，你用什么策略来保持冷静和同理心?
问题3: 你有没有一些缓解压力和情绪紧张的活动或爱好？它们对你有帮助吗？你是如何安排时间去做这些事情的？"}]

topics.title: confidence
topics.questions: [{"en": "Are there people or experiences in your life that have had a positive impact on your self-confidence? What causes you to lose self-confidence? Please share your story.", "zh": "在你的生活中，有哪些人或经历对你的自信心产生了积极的影响？哪些事情使你失去过自信心？请分享一下你的故事。"}, {"en": "What habits, behaviors or ways of thinking do you think can help boost self-confidence? How to maintain confidence without falling into the trap of conceit?", "zh": "自信与自负之间有什么区别？如何保持自信的同时避免陷入自负的陷阱？"}]

topics.title: career development
topics.questions: [{"en": "1. What is your present job? Or what's your major? What is the current employment situation and development prospect of your industry? The rapid development of science and technology and rapid changes in the industry affect every industry and position. How will your work be affected? topics.questions: [{"en": "Where are you at present? What's the special food in your hometown? What is your favorite food in daily life?", "zh": "你自己的饮食习惯是怎样的？日常生活中自己最喜欢吃的食物是什么？"}, {"en": "Food affects your health. Have you paid any attention to your diet? What are your own healthy eating habits?", "zh": "食物影响着健康，你有特意关注过饮食健康吗？自己有哪些健康饮食的习惯？"}]

topics.title: educate
topics.questions: [{"en": "1. How do you feel about your home education? What do you think of the phenomenon that parents will impose their own experiences and feelings on their children's education?", "zh": "家长会把自己的经验和感受强制附加给子女教育，你怎么看待这种现象？"}, {"en": "3. What role do you think college education plays? What is the impact on life and employment?", "zh": "你觉得大学教育扮演什么角色？对生活和就业产生哪些影响？"}, {"en": "4. In order to better adapt to the current social situation, what do you think needs improvement in education?", "zh": "为了更好的适应目前的社会现状，你觉得教育还有哪些需要改进的地方？"}]

topics.title: social media
topics.questions: [{"en": "1. Are you used to sharing your life or opinions on social media (wechat/tiktok/ XiaoHongshu)? When you share content on social media, do you care a lot about what others say? How would you handle a negative comment?", "zh": "2.当你在社交媒体上分享内容后，你会非常在意别人的评价吗？如果有负面评价，你会怎么处理？"}, {"en": "3. How do you see the role of social media in shaping public opinion and disseminating information? Do you think it's positive or negative?", "zh": "3.你如何看待社交媒体在塑造公众舆论和传播信息方面的作用？你认为它是积极的还是消极的？"}]

topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you consider yourself an emotionally stable person? topics.questions: [{"en": "What are your strategies for listening to others' perspectives and remaining open and understanding even when opinions differ?", "zh": "你有哪些策略来倾听他人的观点，即使在意见分歧时也能保持开放和理解的态度？"}, {"en": "At work, if you have a disagreement with your colleagues, how do you express your views while maintaining a good working relationship?", "zh": "在工作中，如果你与同事意见不合，你会如何表达自己的观点同时保持良好的工作关系？"}, {"en": "How important do you think non-verbal communication (e.g. body language, facial expressions) is for effective communication in the workplace? topics.title: personal finance
topics.questions: [{"en": "Do you create a financial plan for yourself? Creating a budget for yourself and so on. What choice do you make? What about these two views?", "zh": "有人喜欢花钱来及时享乐，有人喜欢攒钱来积累积蓄，你自己会怎么选择？怎么看待这两种观点？"}]

topics.title: Daily Roution
topics.questions: [{"en": "What time do you usually wake up in the morning and go to bed at night? topics.title: Innovation
topics.questions: [{"en": "In life, are you accustomed to trying new things? topics.title: After the holiday
topics.questions: [{"en": "How was your Spring Festival holiday? topics.title: Spring Festival
topics.questions: [{"en": "What are the customs of Spring Festival in your hometown?
